66475.recognize_zh: 抹片 (B、C) 中可見體積巨大、細胞質深藍且有突起 (cytoplasmic blebs／dog-ear) 的巨大前紅血球母細胞 (giant pronormoblast)，切片插圖 (A) 有核內包涵體，D 圖 parvovirus B19 免疫染色使紅系前驅細胞核強陽性，可確立 B19 感染。
features: Panels B–C: giant pronormoblasts several times the size of red cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and irregular pseudopod-like cytoplasmic projections
Panels B–C: large round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin; nuclear inclusions are suggested but not sharply resolved on the smear
Panel A (H&E): cellular marrow with granulocytes and megakaryocytes; inset shows an enlarged erythroid precursor with a glassy intranuclear inclusion and peripheral chromatin
Panel D: parvovirus B19 IHC shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining of scattered clusters of enlarged cells in interstitial spaces
Mature erythroid maturation (late normoblasts) is sparse in the aspirate fields
66475.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (panel A) shows a cellular marrow with preserved granulopoiesis and megakaryocytes and scattered enlarged erythroid precursors, one of which (inset) contains a glassy intranuclear inclusion with margination of chromatin. The aspirate smears (panels B and C) show giant pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, cytoplasmic blebs and fine nuclear chromatin, with a paucity of maturing normoblasts. Immunohistochemistry for parvovirus B19 (panel D) highlights clusters of infected erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection of the marrow causing erythroid hypoplasia in an immunosuppressed transplant recipient.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets (>80%) of proerythroblasts with frequent TP53 abnormalities and no viral inclusions, whereas B19 causes erythroid hypoplasia with only scattered giant pronormoblasts and positive B19 IHC or PCR.
Megaloblastic change affects all erythroid stages with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and erythroid hyperplasia rather than isolated giant pronormoblasts with inclusions.
CMV produces owl-eye inclusions in endothelial or stromal cells and HSV multinucleation with ground-glass nuclei, and the respective IHC stains are positive while B19 IHC is negative.

ddx.dx: Thymoma-associated or autoimmune pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Immune PRCA lacks giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions and is B19 IHC/PCR negative.

66347.recognize_zh: 高倍下上方箭頭指出一顆細胞質豐富、核圓並含大型嗜伊紅包涵體樣核仁的單核 Hodgkin 細胞，下方箭頭為深染、不規則的變異型（mummified）細胞；背景為小淋巴球、組織球、嗜伊紅性球與纖維性基質，符合古典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Large mononuclear Hodgkin cell (upper arrow) with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and a round nucleus containing a large inclusion-like nucleolus with perinucleolar clearing
Hyperchromatic, smudged, irregular large cell (lower arrow) consistent with a degenerating mummified variant
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and scattered eosinophils with bright eosinophilic granules
Fibrillary stroma with retraction artifact around lymphocytes
No residual normal hematopoiesis in this field
66347.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and eosinophils within a fibrillary stroma. Scattered large atypical cells are present, including a mononuclear Hodgkin cell with abundant cytoplasm and a large inclusion-like nucleolus, and a hyperchromatic, smudged mummified cell. Normal hematopoietic elements are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by classic Hodgkin lymphoma; immunohistochemistry for CD30, CD15, PAX5 and CD45 is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei with fine chromatin and granular cytoplasm, lack macronucleoli, and are CD61/CD42b positive.
ALCL shows sheets of CD30+ hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei that are EMA and often ALK positive and CD15 negative.
Immunoblasts are smaller with a single central nucleolus, retain CD45 and CD20 or T-cell markers, and lack CD15.
Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin or S100/SOX10 positive rather than CD30/CD15 positive.

65899.recognize_zh: 右下方一顆大型漿細胞內有四個核（四核漿細胞），細胞質豐富灰藍；周圍同時有大量核偏位的單核漿細胞與少數小淋巴球。多核漿細胞本身屬非典型改變，配合大量漿細胞支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。影像略失焦。
features: Large plasma cell with four nuclei clustered within abundant cytoplasm (tetranucleate form, lower right)
Numerous background plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm
Some large plasma cells with open chromatin and visible nucleoli
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional fine cytoplasmic vacuoles
Slight blur and pink precipitate/fibrin in the background
65899.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, including large forms with visible nucleoli. A large tetranucleate plasma cell is present. Scattered small lymphocytes are seen, and image focus is slightly suboptimal. Multinucleated plasma cells are an atypical feature; together with the clinical findings of vertebral fractures, anemia, renal impairment and an M-protein, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma pending plasma cell quantitation and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm and osteoclasts have many separate nuclei with pink granular cytoplasm, whereas this cell has a few eccentric plasma cell-type nuclei in basophilic cytoplasm.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, mononuclear and polytypic, without multinucleated atypical forms.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma with multinucleated tumor cells
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin-positive, whereas plasma cells are discohesive and CD138-positive.

65835.recognize_zh: 中央一顆分葉的嗜中性球，細胞質有細顆粒；標題為 Barr body（鼓槌狀附屬體，drumstick），但在此解析度下無法清楚分辨與核葉相連的小圓形附屬體，需高倍確認，屬部分吻合。
features: Single segmented neutrophil with three to four nuclear lobes and clumped chromatin
Cytoplasm with fine pinkish-lilac granules
A discrete drumstick appendage (about 1.5 microns, attached by a thin chromatin strand) is not clearly resolvable in this image
Background red cells normocytic with central pallor; numerous scattered platelets
Fine stain precipitate across the background
65835.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single segmented neutrophil with three to four lobes, clumped chromatin and finely granular cytoplasm, set in a background of normocytic red cells, scattered platelets and fine stain precipitate. The title indicates a Barr body (drumstick), a small round chromatin appendage attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin strand, but a definite drumstick cannot be distinguished from overlapping lobes at this resolution. The image is therefore only partially illustrative; drumsticks are a normal finding in female neutrophils (inactivated X chromosome) and have no pathological significance.

ddx.dx: Sessile nodule or small nuclear lobe
ddx.vs: Sessile nodules lack the thin stalk and small nuclei lobes are larger and less dense than a 1.5-micron drumstick.
Hypersegmentation means six or more lobes or more than 5% with five lobes, rather than a single small appendage.
Döhle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches, not dense chromatin attached to the nucleus.
Detached nuclear fragments float free in the cytoplasm without a connecting chromatin strand.

65771.recognize_zh: 低倍（×200）腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中，大量中到大型的單核異常細胞成群分布，細胞質淡藍色、數量中等，混有紅血球及少數小淋巴球；在此倍率看不清典型的初級顆粒、Auer 小體或雙葉蝴蝶狀核，需高倍確認為 APL 復發。
features: Markedly hypercellular CSF cytospin with numerous medium-to-large atypical mononuclear cells, often in loose aggregates
Cells have round to irregular or indented nuclei with moderate amounts of pale blue cytoplasm
Occasional small mature lymphocytes provide size comparison
Admixed red cells in the background
Cytoplasmic primary granules, Auer rods and bilobed (butterfly) nuclei are not resolvable at this low magnification
65771.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid at low magnification shows marked hypercellularity composed of numerous medium-to-large atypical mononuclear cells with round to irregular nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, admixed with red cells and occasional small lymphocytes. The diagnostic high-power features of abnormal promyelocytes, including coarse primary granules, Auer rods and bilobed nuclei, cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings indicate CSF involvement by an acute leukemia and, in the documented clinical context with high-power confirmation, are consistent with extramedullary relapse of acute promyelocytic leukemia; PML::RARA testing of the CSF cells can confirm.

ddx.dx: CSF involvement by other acute myeloid leukemia (e.g. monocytic)
ddx.vs: Monoblasts have folded nuclei with grey-blue cytoplasm and fine granules, lack faggot cells, and are PML::RARA negative.
Reactive pleocytosis consists of mature lymphocytes, monocytes or neutrophils rather than a monotonous population of immature cells.
Traumatic tap contamination shows leukocytes in proportion to red cells with a peripheral blood differential, not a dominant immature population.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by lymphoblastic leukemia or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are agranular with scant cytoplasm and are MPO negative, TdT or B/T marker positive.

65707.recognize_zh: 低倍下病灶被纖維帶分隔成結節，高倍在小淋巴球、嗜酸性球與組織球的混合背景中散佈大型、核仁明顯、胞質豐富的 HRS 細胞；CD30 膜狀與高基氏體染色、CD15 陽性、PAX5 弱陽性、LMP1 陽性，符合發生於小腦的典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤。
features: Low power: well-circumscribed lesion subdivided into nodules by fibrous bands
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, neutrophils and histiocytes
Scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with abundant cytoplasm, multilobated nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli (inset)
CD30: membranous and Golgi-pattern staining of large cells; CD15 positive (inset)
PAX5 weak nuclear staining in large cells; MUM1 strong nuclear
EBV LMP1: membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in the large neoplastic cells
65707.describe_en: Excisional biopsy of the cerebellar mass shows at low power a circumscribed nodular lesion with fibrous bands. At higher power there is a polymorphous inflammatory infiltrate of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, neutrophils and histiocytes with scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells bearing multilobated nuclei and prominent nucleoli. The large cells are positive for CD30 (membranous and Golgi) and CD15, weakly positive for PAX5, strongly positive for MUM1 and positive for EBV LMP1, with CD20 and CD45 reported negative. Findings are consistent with EBV-positive classic Hodgkin lymphoma with nodular sclerosis-like features involving the cerebellum.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: PCNSL forms angiocentric sheets of large cells with strong CD20 and PAX5, lacking CD15 and the scattered HRS-cell pattern.
THRLBCL large cells are CD20+/CD45+ and CD30/CD15-negative, in a background devoid of eosinophils.
EBV+ DLBCL cells retain strong CD20/CD79a and CD45, whereas these CD30+/CD15+ cells lack CD20 and CD45.
ALCL shows cohesive sheets of CD30+ hallmark cells that express T-cell antigens or ALK/EMA and are PAX5-negative.

65707.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD15, PAX5, LMP1, MUM1

65067.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中散布多個紅血球碎片：頭盔狀細胞（helmet cell）、三角形與角狀細胞（keratocyte），以及小而無中央淡染的碎片；背景血小板極少、偶見較大的多染性紅血球，符合微血管病變性溶血，配合臨床為 TTP。
features: Numerous schistocytes including helmet cells, triangular fragments, and keratocytes
Small dense fragmented red cells lacking central pallor
Occasional larger polychromatic red cells
Many red cells with a refractile central ring artifact, likely drying-related
Occasional echinocyte/burr cell; platelets markedly decreased in the field
65067.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells, triangular fragments, and keratocytes, together with small dense fragmented red cells. Occasional polychromatic macrocytes are present, and platelets are markedly decreased. Many red cells show a refractile central ring that likely represents drying artifact rather than true target or stomatocytic change. Findings indicate a microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia and, in this clinical context, are consistent with thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura; urgent ADAMTS13 activity testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: HUS shows identical schistocytes but is associated with Shiga toxin or complement dysregulation and ADAMTS13 activity above 10%.
DIC shows prolonged PT/aPTT and low fibrinogen, which are typically normal in TTP.
Valve-related hemolysis has schistocytes with a normal platelet count and a history of a prosthetic valve.
Bite cells have a smooth single semicircular defect with blister cells and Heinz bodies, with normal platelets.

65323.recognize_zh: 這是化療後的右前臂臨床照片：原腫塊處只剩一片界線不清、帶鱗屑的褐紫色色素沉著斑塊，沒有明顯隆起的結節，下方另有小片瘀青，符合 BPDCN 皮膚病灶經 CHOP 治療後明顯消退。
features: Ill-defined brownish-violaceous hyperpigmented patch on the extensor forearm
Overlying fine white scale and dry, atrophic-appearing skin
No visible raised nodule or tumor mass
Small separate purpuric/ecchymotic areas near the elbow and proximal forearm
65323.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the right forearm after one cycle of chemotherapy shows an ill-defined brownish-violaceous hyperpigmented patch with overlying fine scale at the site of the previous lesion, without a visible raised nodule or mass. Small separate purpuric areas are also present. The appearance is consistent with marked regression of the cutaneous blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm lesion with residual post-inflammatory change; clinical and imaging follow-up are needed to confirm response.

ddx.dx: Residual or relapsing BPDCN skin lesion
ddx.vs: Active BPDCN appears as a raised violaceous nodule, plaque or bruise-like tumor, and any persistent induration would need biopsy.
Non-neoplastic pigmentation is flat and stable without a history of an infiltrative mass, requiring clinical correlation.
Thrombocytopenic purpura presents as flat, non-scaly ecchymoses at multiple sites that resolve with platelet recovery.

65195.recognize_zh: 淋巴結可見退化的濾泡與血管豐富的濾泡間區，CD138 顯示濾泡間大量漿細胞（Castleman 病混合型）；同時濾泡間有散在但數量不少、外觀不特別異型的 TdT+/CD99+ 細胞，流式證實為 CD34+/CD10+/cytoCD3+/TdT+ 的不成熟 T 細胞群。
features: Lymph node with preserved nodular architecture, a regressed follicle with concentric mantle lymphocytes, and expanded interfollicular areas
Interfollicular zones show prominent vascularity with plump endothelial cells and mixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells
CD138 highlights sheets and clusters of interfollicular plasma cells, sparing follicles
TdT shows numerous scattered interfollicular nuclear-positive cells, co-expressing CD99 (inset), without cytologic atypia on H&E
Flow cytometry: discrete dim CD45 population (green) expressing CD34, CD10, cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT
65195.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows preserved architecture with regressed follicles and expanded, highly vascular interfollicular areas containing sheets of CD138-positive plasma cells, consistent with Castleman disease, mixed (hyaline-vascular and plasma cell) features. In addition, numerous scattered TdT- and CD99-positive cells are present in the interfollicular regions without forming sheets or showing overt atypia on H&E. Flow cytometry identifies a discrete immature T-cell population with dim CD45, CD34, CD10, cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT expression; TCR gene rearrangement studies were polyclonal. In the clinical context, findings are consistent with HHV-8-negative idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease with a modest non-clonal immature T-lymphoblastic proliferation.

ddx.vs: T-LBL shows diffuse effacing sheets of atypical blasts with clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas here TdT+ cells are scattered interfollicular cells in preserved architecture without clonality.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-lymphoblastic proliferation (e.g., with Castleman, FDC sarcoma, hepatocellular carcinoma)
ddx.vs: This entity is essentially what is shown, distinguished from T-LBL by lack of atypia, clusters rather than sheets, and polyclonal TCR.
HHV-8 MCD shows LANA-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zones, whereas LANA immunostain was negative here.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm or lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells are light-chain restricted and destroy architecture, whereas Castleman interfollicular plasma cells are polytypic.

65195.stain: H&E; IHC: CD138, TdT, CD99; flow

64939.recognize_zh: 抹片體部可見一團無結構、淡藍紫色的均質沉積物（箭頭），內外夾雜被困住的紅血球，周邊白血球形態正常；這種淡藍色無細胞團塊是冷凝球蛋白（cryoglobulin）在室溫下沉澱的表現。
features: Irregular, amorphous, homogeneous pale blue-violet extracellular deposit in the body of the smear (arrow)
Red cells trapped at the edges of and overlying the deposit, some distorted
Deposit is acellular without internal structure, nuclei or granules
Background red cells normochromic with mild anisocytosis; neutrophils morphologically unremarkable
64939.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an irregular, acellular, pale blue amorphous extracellular deposit in the body of the smear, with red cells trapped at its margins. The surrounding red cells are normochromic with mild anisocytosis, and the neutrophils appear morphologically unremarkable. In a patient with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, these pale blue precipitates are suggestive of cryoglobulin deposition; confirmation requires a warm-collected sample for cryoglobulin testing, and repeat smears from a prewarmed specimen should lack the deposits.

ddx.vs: Smudged cells retain nuclear chromatin strands and are purple, whereas cryoglobulin deposits are nuclei-free pale blue homogeneous material.
High paraprotein produces diffuse bluish background staining and rouleaux throughout the smear rather than discrete globular clumps.
Stain precipitate is dark, granular and crystalline, not pale homogeneous amorphous material.
Platelet clumps are granular aggregates of individual platelets with purple granulomere, unlike structureless pale blue deposits.

64683.recognize_zh: 肺泡灌洗液抹片中，巨噬細胞細胞質內充滿粗大、藍黑至藍綠色的顆粒（黑箭頭，含鐵血黃素），另有巨噬細胞吞入紅血球（白箭頭），提示肺泡出血。
features: Clusters of alveolar macrophages with abundant foamy, vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm
Coarse, refractile blue-black to blue-green cytoplasmic granules (hemosiderin) in several macrophages (black arrows)
Macrophage with ingested red cells/red cell fragments (erythrophagocytosis, white arrow)
Round eccentric nuclei of macrophages; scattered neutrophils and lymphocytes
Scattered free red cells in a clean background; no organisms or malignant cells seen
64683.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid shows numerous alveolar macrophages, some forming small clusters, with scattered neutrophils and lymphocytes. Several macrophages contain coarse blue-black granular pigment consistent with hemosiderin (black arrows), and one macrophage contains ingested red blood cells (white arrow). No malignant cells or microorganisms are identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with alveolar hemorrhage, with both remote (hemosiderin-laden macrophages) and recent (erythrophagocytosis) components; a Prussian blue stain can confirm and quantify hemosiderin.

ddx.vs: Carbon pigment is jet-black and non-refractile and is Prussian blue negative, whereas hemosiderin appears blue-green to golden and is iron positive.
Iatrogenic bleeding shows free red cells without hemosiderin, since hemosiderin takes about 48-72 hours to form.
Fungi show defined hyphae or yeast forms with walls on GMS/PAS rather than irregular coarse pigment granules.
Erythrophagocytosis in BAL is a local response to hemorrhage, whereas HLH requires systemic criteria and marrow/organ hemophagocytosis of multiple lineages.

64491.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下腎絲球微血管壁內皮下（藍箭頭）有大片電子緻密沉積，呈多個有稜角、帶平行條紋的晶格狀小塊聚集，位於內皮細胞與基底膜之間，提示結晶化單株免疫球蛋白沉積。
features: Large subendothelial electron-dense deposits between endothelium and glomerular basement membrane (arrow)
Deposits composed of aggregated angular fragments with focal parallel striated/crystalline substructure
Widened subendothelial space with capillary lumen narrowing
Adjacent endothelial/mesangial cells with prominent nuclei and podocyte foot processes on the outer aspect
No evident subepithelial humps in this field
64491.describe_en: Transmission electron micrograph of a glomerular capillary loop shows a large subendothelial electron-dense deposit (blue arrow) expanding the space between the endothelium and the glomerular basement membrane. The deposit is composed of aggregated angular, partly striated fragments, suggesting an organized crystalline substructure rather than amorphous immune complexes. Adjacent capillary lumens are narrowed, and subepithelial deposits are not evident in this field. In a patient with CLL and a membranoproliferative pattern, findings are consistent with subendothelial crystalline paraprotein deposits; immunofluorescence for light-chain restriction and serum cryoglobulin studies are needed.

ddx.vs: Lupus deposits are amorphous with tubuloreticular inclusions in endothelium and full-house immunofluorescence, lacking crystalline substructure.
Cryoglobulin deposits often show curved microtubular or annular substructure with intraluminal pseudothrombi, whereas crystalline deposits show straight lattice striations.
Immunotactoid shows hollow microtubules >30 nm in parallel arrays, rather than solid angular crystals.
TMA shows electron-lucent subendothelial widening with flocculent material and new basement membrane, not electron-dense organized deposits.

64619.recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞核卵圓、染色質細緻，淡藍色細顆粒狀細胞質中含三顆被吞噬、周圍有空泡的紅血球，代表噬紅血球現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and a single oval eccentric nucleus
Three intact phagocytosed red cells within clear cytoplasmic vacuoles (phagosomes)
Nuclear chromatin fine to moderately condensed without visible nucleoli
Cell membrane with fine cytoplasmic fraying at edges
Background of thick, clumped red cell areas typical of aspirate smear; no other nucleated cells in field
64619.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and an oval nucleus with fine chromatin. The cytoplasm contains three intact phagocytosed erythrocytes, each within a clear vacuole. The surrounding background consists of red cells without other nucleated elements in this field. Findings represent hemophagocytosis (erythrophagocytosis); in the appropriate clinical context this supports but is not by itself diagnostic of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis involves intact hematopoietic cells passing through a large lobulated megakaryocyte, whereas this is a mononuclear macrophage containing digested red cells in phagosomes.
Superimposed red cells lie on top of the cytoplasm without surrounding clear phagocytic vacuoles and appear in different focal planes.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion or infection
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; clinical HLH criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, sCD25, NK function) rather than a single hemophagocyte separate HLH from nonspecific reactive phagocytosis.

ddx.dx: Erythrophagocytosis by leukemic blasts (e.g., AML with t(8;16))
ddx.vs: In t(8;16) AML the phagocytic cells are monocytic blasts with immature chromatin and nucleoli, unlike this mature macrophage.

64427.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片低倍可見紅血球成團凝集，高倍下中性球細胞質內吞入整顆紅血球，將分葉核推擠到一側（紅血球吞噬），另有單核球含空泡狀已消化的紅血球；配合 C3 陽性 DAT 與黴漿菌感染，符合陣發性冷血紅素尿症（PCH）。
features: Panel A: red cell agglutinates and scattered spherocyte-like dense red cells at low power
Neutrophils containing one intact engulfed red cell that compresses and displaces the segmented nucleus (panels B, C)
Phagocytosed red cells are pink, round and sit in clear vacuoles with adjacent small vacuoles
Panel D: monocyte with fine grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm containing a pale, partially digested red cell ghost
Background shows few red cells, consistent with severe anemia
64427.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anemia with red cell agglutinates. Several neutrophils contain engulfed intact erythrocytes within cytoplasmic vacuoles, indenting and displacing the segmented nuclei, and a monocyte contains a pale, partially digested red cell ghost. Schistocytes and intracellular organisms are not seen. In a child with intravascular hemolysis, a C3-positive/IgG-negative direct antiglobulin test and recent Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection, findings are consistent with erythrophagocytosis by neutrophils and monocytes in paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: Cold agglutinin disease shows prominent agglutination due to IgM anti-I, usually in adults, with extravascular hemolysis and rarely neutrophil erythrophagocytosis; the Donath-Landsteiner biphasic IgG hemolysin separates PCH.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with IgG-positive DAT and little agglutination, whereas PCH is C3-only DAT-positive with a biphasic hemolysin.
HLH shows histiocytes (mainly in marrow) ingesting multiple cell types with cytopenias and HLH criteria, not neutrophils engulfing red cells in the blood.
Parasitic infections show intraerythrocytic ring forms or tetrads within circulating red cells rather than whole red cells inside neutrophils.

64363.recognize_zh: 三格中的吞噬細胞內含一團均質、無染色質紋理的圓形粉紫色物質（蘇木紫小體），把吞噬細胞本身的分葉核擠成新月狀貼在邊緣，這就是 LE 細胞；此圖失焦且染色偏紅，細節有限。
features: Phagocytic cells (neutrophils) each containing a large, round, homogeneous, smooth magenta inclusion without chromatin texture (hematoxylin body)
Ingested material occupies most of the cell, displacing the phagocyte's nucleus
Phagocyte nuclear lobes compressed into crescent shapes at the cell periphery
Adjacent cells with lobated nuclei in the background (upper left panel)
Composite of three panels; images are out of focus and overstained, limiting fine detail
64363.describe_en: Peripheral blood preparation, shown as a three-panel composite, contains neutrophils that have engulfed a large, round, homogeneous, structureless magenta inclusion. The inclusion displaces the phagocyte's own nuclear lobes, which are compressed into crescents at the periphery. The images are out of focus and intensely stained, limiting assessment of cytoplasmic detail. Findings are consistent with LE cells, supporting the clinical diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus, although serologic testing (ANA, anti-dsDNA) has replaced the LE cell preparation.

ddx.vs: In a tart cell, usually a monocyte or macrophage, the ingested nucleus keeps visible chromatin structure, whereas an LE cell's hematoxylin body is homogeneous and structureless.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil phagocytosing an apoptotic cell or red cell
ddx.vs: Ingested apoptotic cells show dense pyknotic fragments and ingested red cells stay pale orange-pink, unlike a single large smooth magenta nuclear mass.
A free hematoxylin body lies outside cells and a smudge cell has a spread, lacy chromatin pattern, whereas an LE cell requires intracellular engulfment with nuclear displacement.

64235.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下，造血組織被成片黏聚的非造血上皮細胞取代，核大、泡狀、有明顯核仁，並形成小腺腔／篩狀空隙，中央可見壞死碎屑，屬轉移性腺癌的型態。
features: Cohesive sheets of large atypical epithelioid cells with no intervening hematopoiesis
Enlarged oval to round vesicular nuclei with visible nucleoli and moderate pleomorphism
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Small round gland-like lumens and cribriform spaces within the sheets
Central zone of discohesive, degenerating cells with nuclear debris suggestive of necrosis
64235.describe_en: High-power view of an H&E-stained bone marrow trephine biopsy shows marrow replaced by cohesive sheets of large atypical epithelial cells with vesicular nuclei, visible nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. The cells form small acinar and cribriform lumens, and a central area of discohesion with apoptotic and necrotic debris is present. No normal hematopoietic elements are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow; immunohistochemistry (e.g., PSA, NKX3.1) supports prostatic origin in this case.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are larger with lobulated nuclei and do not form lumens, and osteoblasts line trabeculae with eccentric nuclei and a paranuclear hof rather than forming cohesive glandular sheets.

ddx.dx: Large B-cell lymphoma or plasmablastic neoplasm
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are discohesive without glandular lumens and are CD45/CD20 or CD138 positive and cytokeratin negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These tumors have smaller cells with scant cytoplasm and form rosettes rather than acini, and are cytokeratin negative with lineage-specific markers.

64171.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD34 免疫染色中，大型、核淡染的上皮樣細胞群完全不著色，只有零星小型細胞與竇狀血管內皮呈棕色陽性（內部對照），表示這群上皮樣細胞不是母細胞（blast）增生。
features: Cellular marrow with a population of large epithelioid cells with ovoid vesicular nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm
Epithelioid cells are negative for CD34
Positive internal control: rare small scattered CD34-positive cells and linear staining of sinusoidal endothelium
No increase in CD34-positive blasts or clusters
Adipocyte spaces interspersed; faint nonspecific background cytoplasmic blush
64171.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core biopsy shows that the large epithelioid cells are negative. CD34 highlights only rare scattered small cells and sinusoidal endothelium, which serve as an internal positive control, with no increase or clustering of CD34-positive blasts. Together with CD163 positivity in the epithelioid cells, the CD34-negative profile argues against a blast-rich myeloid process or vascular neoplasm and supports a histiocytic lineage for the infiltrate.

ddx.vs: Blast excess would show numerous or clustered CD34-positive small-to-medium cells, whereas only rare isolated positive cells are present here.
Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma/angiosarcoma cells typically express CD34 and/or CD31/ERG, unlike the CD34-negative epithelioid cells here.
Carcinoma is CD34-negative as well, so it is excluded by strong diffuse keratin and lack of CD163, not by CD34.

64107.recognize_zh: 一顆分葉嗜中性球的胞質內擠滿數個大小不一、比一般空泡大得多的圓形白色透明吞噬體（phagosome），把分葉核推擠變形；在冷凝球蛋白血症病人，這是嗜中性球吞噬冷凝球蛋白的樣子。
features: Mature neutrophil with a segmented nucleus distorted by cytoplasmic contents
Several large, round, clear-to-pale phagosomes, larger than typical toxic vacuoles
Additional smaller vacuoles in the remaining cytoplasm
Faint pinkish cytoplasmic granulation; toxic granulation not clearly resolved at this image quality
Surrounding red cells overlapping in a thick area; no extracellular deposits evident
64107.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil whose cytoplasm contains several large, round, clear phagosomes that are considerably larger than ordinary toxic vacuoles and indent the segmented nucleus. Smaller vacuoles are also present, while the image quality limits assessment of toxic granulation. No organisms are seen within the vacuoles. In a patient with cryoglobulinemic vasculitis, these features are consistent with neutrophil phagocytosis of cryoglobulin; correlation with cryoglobulin testing on a sample kept at 37 °C is recommended.

ddx.vs: Toxic vacuoles are small, multiple, and uniformly distributed with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, rather than a few large phagosomes.
Storage vacuoles are small and punched-out, appear after prolonged standing, and lack the large ingested globules seen here.
Microorganisms show visible basophilic rods, cocci, or yeast forms inside the vacuoles, which are absent here.
Jordans anomaly shows fat-containing vacuoles in all neutrophils and often monocytes, as an inherited finding rather than an acquired phagocytic event.

63915.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中片狀分布的中至大型母細胞，核形不規則、有摺痕或凹陷、染色質細緻、細胞質少且淡，並可見多個有絲分裂像，正常造血細胞僅零星殘存；配合免疫染色支持 BPDCN。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large immature cells replacing hematopoietic marrow between fat spaces
Irregular, folded or indented nuclear contours with fine to slightly vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Frequent mitotic figures
Only scattered residual eosinophils, neutrophils and erythroid cells
63915.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows diffuse sheets of medium-to-large blastic cells between adipocytes. The cells have irregular, folded or indented nuclei with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, and mitotic figures are readily found. Residual hematopoietic elements are limited to scattered granulocytes and erythroid cells. The morphology is that of a high-grade blastic neoplasm and is not lineage-specific; immunohistochemistry demonstrating CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1 without myeloid or lymphoid markers supports blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts also have folded nuclei but express lysozyme, CD163 or MPO and lack TCL1.
Lymphoblasts show similar fine chromatin and mitoses but are TdT-positive with B or T lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5.
Blastoid MCL has similar cytology but is CD5- and cyclin D1-positive B cells.

63851.recognize_zh: HPLC 圖中 HbA（Ao 63.7%）旁邊，在 4.34 分鐘的 S-window 有一個 26.1% 的變異峰，HbA2 3.3%、HbF 1.2% 正常；HbA 多於變異血紅素、S 窗峰約 25–40%，符合母親為鐮刀型血紅素帶因（HbS trait）。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC report with peak table and chromatogram
Dominant Ao (HbA) peak at 2.43 min, 63.7%
Variant peak at 4.34 min in the S-window, 26.1%
HbA2 3.3% and HbF 1.2%, within the expected range for an S carrier
No D-window peak
63851.describe_en: Cation-exchange HPLC shows a major HbA peak (63.7%) and a variant peak eluting at 4.34 minutes in the S-window, comprising 26.1% of total hemoglobin. HbA2 is 3.3% and HbF 1.2%, and no D-window peak is present. HbA exceeding the variant, with an S-window fraction in the typical carrier range, is the characteristic heterozygous pattern; a positive sickling or solubility test would confirm HbS. Findings are consistent with sickle cell trait (HbAS) in the mother of the index case.

ddx.vs: HbD elutes earlier in the D-window (about 4.0-4.1 min) and is sickling-test negative, whereas HbS elutes at about 4.3-4.4 min.
In S/beta+-thalassemia the HbS fraction exceeds HbA and HbA2 is raised with microcytosis, the opposite of the HbA > HbS carrier pattern here.
Coinherited alpha-thalassemia lowers the HbS fraction (often below 30%) with microcytic indices, so a low-normal S percentage should prompt alpha-globin gene testing if indices are microcytic.

63787.recognize_zh: 掃描倍率下破碎的骨髓切片中，骨小樑間的髓腔被一致性的粉紫色細胞浸潤填滿，幾乎沒有脂肪空泡，需在高倍下確認為肉芽腫性發炎。
features: Fragmented bone marrow core with multiple pieces of cortical and trabecular bone
Intertrabecular spaces diffusely filled by a dense, fairly homogeneous pink-purple cellular infiltrate
Marked loss of marrow fat spaces
No discrete well-formed granulomas or necrosis discernible at scanning magnification
Specific cell types cannot be resolved at this power
63787.describe_en: Scanning-power view of a fragmented bone marrow core biopsy shows intertrabecular spaces diffusely occupied by a dense cellular infiltrate with near-complete loss of marrow fat. The cellular composition, the presence of discrete granulomas, and necrosis cannot be assessed at this magnification. Higher-power examination, together with special stains for microorganisms and immunohistochemistry, is required. In this case, higher-power views demonstrated granulomatous inflammation.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma or leukemia with diffuse marrow replacement
ddx.vs: At higher power shows monotonous atypical lymphoid cells or blasts rather than epithelioid histiocytes.
Higher power reveals cohesive atypical epithelial nests, often with desmoplasia, confirmed by keratin staining.
Shows panmyelosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters rather than histiocytic aggregates.
Streaming spindle cells and collagen with reduced cellularity instead of a dense cellular infiltrate.

63659.recognize_zh: 中央巨噬細胞的細胞質充滿大量大小不一的透明空泡（泡沫狀），核位於中央；四周圍著一圈多染性與正染性紅血球母細胞，構成紅血球島（erythroblastic island）。
features: Central macrophage with abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous clear vacuoles of varying size (foamy)
Single central oval nucleus with fine chromatin
Scattered purple debris and ingested material in the cytoplasm
Ring of polychromatophilic and orthochromatic erythroblasts with round dense nuclei surrounding the macrophage
Nearby neutrophil and band form; background red cells
63659.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an erythroblastic island composed of a central macrophage surrounded by a ring of polychromatophilic and orthochromatic erythroblasts. The macrophage has a central oval nucleus and abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous clear vacuoles of varying size and scattered ingested debris. The surrounding erythroblasts show normoblastic maturation without evident dysplasia in this field. Findings are consistent with a foamy central (nurse) macrophage of an erythroblastic island, a physiologic structure.

ddx.dx: Niemann-Pick or other lipid storage foam cells
ddx.vs: Storage foam cells are numerous, filled with uniform small vacuoles, and not typically isolated island centers; enzyme and genetic testing confirm.
Hemophagocytes contain engulfed intact red cells, nucleated cells, or platelets rather than clear vacuoles with surrounding (not ingested) erythroblasts.
Gaucher cells have fibrillar striated cytoplasm rather than discrete vacuoles.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters of atypical epithelial cells that are keratin positive.

63595.recognize_zh: 一顆體積很大、胞質豐富呈淡紫粉紅細顆粒狀的巨核細胞，卻只有一個偏心、不分葉的橢圓形核，這種單核／低分葉巨核細胞（hypolobated megakaryocyte）是骨髓發育不良的線索，常見於 MDS with del(5q)。
features: Very large cell with abundant pale lilac, finely granular cytoplasm typical of a mature megakaryocyte
Single, eccentric, non-lobated oval nucleus with dense chromatin
Nucleus disproportionately small relative to the mature cytoplasm (nuclear-cytoplasmic maturation asynchrony)
Smooth, well-demarcated cell border without obvious platelet budding
Background of red cell aggregates and scattered small lymphoid and myeloid cells
63595.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant, finely granular, mature-appearing cytoplasm and a single eccentric, non-lobated oval nucleus. Surrounding cells include small mononuclear hematopoietic cells in a red cell-rich background. A single cell cannot establish dysplasia, which requires at least 10% dysplastic megakaryocytes among those evaluated. Findings are consistent with a hypolobated megakaryocyte, a dysplastic form characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q) and also seen in other MDS.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small (lymphocyte to myelocyte-sized) with scant cytoplasm, whereas this cell is full-sized with a single round nucleus.
Immature megakaryocytes have scant deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm, whereas this cell has mature granular cytoplasm with an unlobed nucleus.
CML megakaryocytes are small hypolobated 'dwarf' forms, and ET megakaryocytes are giant with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei, rather than a large cell with a single round nucleus.
Histiocytes have vacuolated pale cytoplasm with phagocytic debris and osteoblasts have basophilic cytoplasm with a Golgi zone, unlike the fine azurophilic granularity of megakaryocytes.

63531.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中一群細胞，核卵圓偏位、染色質中度緻密，細胞質豐富並散布細小紫紅色顆粒但分布稀疏不均，部分細胞輪廓拉長，顆粒也散落在背景中，符合叢聚的腫瘤性肥大細胞。
features: Cohesive cluster of medium-to-large mononuclear cells
Oval to round, eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Abundant pale cytoplasm with fine purple-red metachromatic granules, hypogranular and unevenly distributed
Irregular, ill-defined cytoplasmic borders with some elongated cell outlines
Granules released into the background; few admixed red cells and small lymphoid/erythroid cells
63531.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a cohesive cluster of medium-to-large cells with oval, eccentrically placed nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and abundant pale cytoplasm containing fine purple-red granules. Granulation is sparse and uneven compared with normal mast cells, cell borders are ill-defined with some elongated outlines, and free granules are present in the background. No significant numbers of blasts are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a cluster of atypical, hypogranular neoplastic mast cells in systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are single, round cells whose densely packed granules obscure the nucleus, not clusters of hypogranular cells with elongated outlines.
Plasma cells have agranular deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin.
Macrophages have vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytosed debris and folded nuclei rather than fine uniform metachromatic granules.
Mast cell leukemia requires at least 20% mast cells on the aspirate smear, often immature metachromatic blast-like forms, so a quantitative count is needed rather than a single cluster.

63467.recognize_zh: 周邊血片右下方有一顆大型空泡狀細胞，細胞核偏心，灰藍色細胞質中包含一個深染的小圓形核（被吞噬細胞的殘核）和一個圓環狀被吞噬物，顯示循環中的組織球正在進行吞噬血球（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large mononuclear cell with an eccentric round to oval nucleus and moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Intracytoplasmic ingested material: a small dense round nucleus and a ring-shaped inclusion within a vacuole
Ingested material consistent with phagocytosed nucleated cell/red cell remnants
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis, a neutrophil, and abundant platelets
63467.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large cell with an eccentric nucleus and abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm containing phagocytosed material, including a small dense pyknotic nucleus and a ring-shaped inclusion within a phagocytic vacuole. The surrounding red cells show mild poikilocytosis, and platelets are abundant. Findings are consistent with a circulating hemophagocytic histiocyte; while not diagnostic in isolation, this finding should prompt clinical and laboratory evaluation for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) or severe infection.

ddx.dx: Monocyte with ingested debris in an in vitro aged sample
ddx.vs: Delayed processing can cause monocytes to phagocytose cells in the tube, so correlation with a fresh sample and clinical HLH criteria is needed.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil or monocyte with intracellular organisms (e.g., Histoplasma, Ehrlichia morulae)
ddx.vs: Organisms appear as uniform small yeasts with halos or basophilic stippled morulae rather than a single pyknotic nucleus and ring-shaped red cell remnant.
Monocytes ingesting antibody-coated red cells are seen with spherocytes and a positive direct antiglobulin test, rather than ingestion of nucleated cells.

63403.recognize_zh: 肝臟 H&E 切片中，擴張的肝竇內充滿成群的小圓形、深染核的細胞（紅血球系前驅細胞），夾雜紅血球，另見一顆大型多分葉核的巨核細胞位於肝細胞板間，這些造血細胞出現在肝臟即為髓外造血。
features: Hepatocyte plates with dilated sinusoids
Clusters of small round cells with dense, dark round nuclei (erythroid precursors) within sinusoids
Large megakaryocyte with multilobated hyperchromatic nucleus in the sinusoid (center-left)
Admixed mature red cells and scattered granulocytic cells
Hepatocytes show preserved architecture without mass lesion
63403.describe_en: Liver biopsy shows preserved hepatocyte plates with dilated sinusoids containing numerous clusters of hematopoietic cells, predominantly erythroid precursors with round, dense nuclei, admixed with red cells. A large megakaryocyte with a multilobated hyperchromatic nucleus is also present within the sinusoids. No mass-forming infiltrate or atypical blast population is seen. Findings are consistent with hepatic extramedullary hematopoiesis, as seen in the setting of post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma or leukemia with sinusoidal infiltration
ddx.vs: Neoplastic infiltrates are monotonous and lack the trilineage mix of erythroid clusters and megakaryocytes.
Inflammatory infiltrates consist of lymphocytes and plasma cells with hepatocyte injury, not erythroid islands and megakaryocytes.
Carcinoma shows cohesive nests with nuclear molding and keratin/neuroendocrine positivity rather than sinusoidal erythroid clusters.
Shows sinusoidal histiocytes with phagocytosed cells, which are CD68/CD163 positive, rather than CD71-positive erythroid islands.

63275.recognize_zh: 100 倍血液抹片（A、B）可清楚看到盔形細胞（helmet cell）、角形細胞（keratocyte）與三角形碎片等破碎紅血球，並夾雜棘狀紅血球及略大偏藍的多染性紅血球；碎裂紅血球加上網狀紅血球反應，符合機械性溶血性貧血。
features: Composite of two high-power peripheral blood fields (A, B)
Schistocytes: helmet cells, keratocytes (horn cells) and small triangular/irregular fragments
Echinocytic/crenated red cells and occasional larger bluish polychromatophilic red cells
Panel A: a large mononuclear cell with an indented nucleus and a small lymphocyte
Panel B: a basophil with coarse dark granules obscuring the nucleus and a segmented neutrophil
Scattered platelets present
63275.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power (two fields) shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells, keratocytes and small triangular fragments, together with crenated red cells and occasional polychromatophilic macrocytes indicating a reticulocyte response. Leukocytes, including a neutrophil, a basophil, a lymphocyte and a larger mononuclear cell, show no significant abnormalities, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with intravascular fragmentation hemolysis, compatible with mechanical hemolytic anemia such as that related to valvular heart disease or a prosthetic valve.

ddx.vs: Schistocytes are similar, but TTP has severe thrombocytopenia and ADAMTS13 activity below 10%, whereas platelets are present here.
Fragments occur with thrombocytopenia and coagulation abnormalities (prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen, high D-dimer).
Produces bite and blister cells with Heinz bodies rather than helmet cells and small triangular schistocytes.
Spur cells and burr cells have multiple projections on otherwise intact cells, without sharp-edged fragmented forms.

63211.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片（上下兩格）中，骨小樑之間的骨髓腔除了脂肪細胞外，大片區域被淡粉紅色、無細胞的無定形物質填滿，造血細胞只剩零散小群；在低倍下就能看出這種間質沉積，提示類澱粉（amyloid）。
features: Low-power trephine with thin bony trabeculae and intertrabecular marrow spaces
Abundant pale eosinophilic, acellular, amorphous interstitial material filling spaces between adipocytes
Residual hematopoietic cells in small patches and scattered singly around the deposits
Preserved fat cells; no discrete tumor nodules at this magnification
63211.describe_en: Low-power views of a bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, two fields) show thin bony trabeculae with intertrabecular marrow containing preserved adipocytes. Much of the interstitium is occupied by pale eosinophilic, acellular, amorphous material, with residual hematopoietic cells arranged in small patches and scattered singly around the deposits. No discrete nodules or sheets of tumor cells are identified at this magnification, and cytologic detail of plasma cells cannot be assessed. The pattern is suggestive of interstitial amyloid deposition, which should be confirmed by Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence and accompanied by CD138 and kappa/lambda studies.

ddx.vs: Occurs in cachexia with atrophic fat cells and pale basophilic-pink granular ground substance that is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.
Edema is paler and wispy and hemorrhage consists of red cells, neither forming dense amorphous waxy deposits.
Fibrosis shows streaming spindle cells and collagen demonstrated by reticulin/trichrome rather than structureless material.

63147.recognize_zh: A 圖新生兒臉頰與額頭有散在的紫藍色斑丘疹（blueberry muffin 樣），代表皮膚髓外造血；B 圖周邊血可見大量不同成熟階段的有核紅血球（箭頭）與多染性紅血球，反映嚴重溶血後的強烈紅血球生成，符合丙酮酸激酶缺乏症。
features: Panel A (clinical photo): neonate with scattered bluish-purple macules/papules over the cheek and forehead, with nasal cannula in place
Panel B: numerous circulating nucleated red cells at different stages, from larger basophilic/polychromatic erythroblasts (black arrows) to small orthochromatic forms (double white arrow)
Polychromatic red cells/reticulocytes (white arrow)
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including irregularly contracted and occasional spiculated forms
No blasts or leukemic cells apparent in the field
63147.describe_en: Composite figure. The clinical photograph (A) shows a neonate with multiple bluish-purple macules and papules on the face, consistent with cutaneous extramedullary hematopoiesis (blueberry muffin lesions). The peripheral blood smear (B) shows marked erythroblastosis with numerous nucleated red cells spanning polychromatic to orthochromatic stages, along with polychromatic red cells and anisopoikilocytosis including irregularly contracted and spiculated cells. No blasts are identified. In the clinical context, findings are consistent with severe congenital hemolytic anemia due to pyruvate kinase deficiency with dermal extramedullary hematopoiesis; confirmation requires PK enzyme assay or PKLR sequencing.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (alloimmune)
ddx.vs: HDFN shows similar erythroblastosis but has a positive DAT and maternal alloantibody, with spherocytes in ABO disease.
Congenital infection also causes blueberry muffin lesions but shows serologic/PCR evidence of infection and often thrombocytopenia without inherited red cell enzyme deficiency.

ddx.dx: Neonatal leukemia or neuroblastoma skin involvement
ddx.vs: Leukemia cutis or metastatic neuroblastoma lesions contain blasts or small round blue tumor cells on biopsy, and blood shows circulating blasts rather than erythroblasts.
HS shows numerous spherocytes with increased osmotic fragility/EMA reduction rather than a nonspherocytic picture with irregularly contracted cells.

63083.recognize_zh: A 圖周邊血見中等大小、核質比高、核稍不規則的母細胞；B 圖流式顯示 cCD3+、CD45 弱、CD1a+、CD5+、CD2+、CD7+；C 圖組織由單一形態小至中型淋巴細胞瀰漫取代且 CD1a 瀰漫陽性；CD1a 陽性提示皮質型 T 淋巴母細胞白血病/淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: blasts of small to medium size with high N:C ratio, scant basophilic cytoplasm and slightly irregular or indented nuclei
Panel A: moderately condensed to fine chromatin without visible nucleoli or granules
Panel B: cytoplasmic CD3 positive with dim CD45; CD1a+/CD5+ and CD2+/CD7+ populations
Panel C-i: diffuse sheets of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells (HES)
Panel C-ii: diffuse membranous CD1a staining of the infiltrate
63083.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with high N:C ratios, slightly irregular nuclei, fairly condensed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. Flow cytometry demonstrates cytoplasmic CD3 with dim CD45 and coexpression of CD1a, CD5, CD2 and CD7. The tissue section shows diffuse sheets of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells that are diffusely CD1a-positive. The immunophenotype corresponds to a cortical T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma; TdT or CD34 staining would further confirm precursor status.

ddx.vs: T-PLL cells have prominent nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs and are TdT-negative and CD1a-negative mature T cells.
Thymoma contains CD1a+/TdT+ immature T cells but also a cytokeratin-positive epithelial meshwork and no circulating blasts.
ETP-ALL is CD1a-negative and CD8-negative with stem/myeloid markers, whereas these blasts are strongly CD1a-positive.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mature T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Mature T-cell lymphomas are surface CD3-positive, TdT/CD1a-negative and often show loss of CD7.

63019.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中多個大型細胞，胞質豐富且深藍色、核偏心呈圓形，核旁有明顯淡染區（perinuclear hof），細胞比旁邊的嗜中性球大上兩三倍；成群的大型不成熟漿細胞是漿細胞骨髓瘤的典型表現。
features: Large plasma cells, two to three times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a distinct pale perinuclear hof
Eccentric round nuclei with relatively fine, evenly distributed chromatin (immature forms)
Moderate variation in plasma cell size; low N:C ratio
Scattered segmented neutrophils and a small lymphocyte for size reference
63019.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows numerous large plasma cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentrically placed round nuclei, and prominent perinuclear hofs. The chromatin is finer than the coarse clock-face pattern of mature plasma cells, and the cells vary in size, indicating immature morphology. Nucleoli are not clearly resolved owing to focus. Adjacent neutrophils appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma, correlating with the reported 60% marrow plasma cells and monoclonal paraprotein.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small and mature with coarse clock-face chromatin, rarely exceed 10% of marrow cells, and are polytypic.
Plasmablasts have high N:C ratios, open chromatin with a large central nucleolus and scant cytoplasm, rather than abundant cytoplasm with a hof.
Pronormoblasts also have deep blue cytoplasm but show central nuclei, a perinuclear clear zone rather than a paranuclear Golgi hof, cytoplasmic blebs and CD71/E-cadherin positivity rather than CD138.

62955.recognize_zh: Ki-67 免疫染色下，淋巴瘤細胞區約有 30–40% 核呈不同強度的陽性，中央一條由小血管與梭形間質細胞構成的區域幾乎陰性；這種中等增生指數是評估被套細胞淋巴瘤預後（>30% 為高風險）時要看的重點。
features: Nuclear Ki-67 positivity in a substantial subset of lymphoma cells (roughly 30-40% by visual estimate)
Heterogeneous staining intensity, from strong to weak nuclear staining
Positive cells distributed diffusely within the neoplastic lymphoid areas
Central band of largely negative spindle stromal cells around a small vessel
Background tumor cells small to medium-sized with round nuclei
62955.describe_en: Ki-67 immunostain shows nuclear positivity in a substantial subset of the lymphoma cells, estimated visually at approximately 30-40%, with variable staining intensity. Positive cells are distributed throughout the lymphoid sheets, whereas a central band of spindle stromal cells around a small vessel is largely negative. The proliferation index is moderately elevated; in mantle cell lymphoma a Ki-67 of 30% or more is an adverse prognostic factor, so a formal count in hot spots is recommended.

ddx.vs: Blastoid variants usually have Ki-67 well above 50% with large or blast-like cells, higher than seen here.
Indolent MCL typically has Ki-67 below 10%, lower than this field.
Reactive germinal centers show zonal, polarized Ki-67 (>90% in dark zone) confined to follicles, unlike this diffuse distribution.

62891.recognize_zh: 這是光穿透式血小板凝集檢查（LTA）的曲線與數據：只有高劑量 ristocetin（1.2 mg/mL）出現完整凝集（最大 104%），ADP、epinephrine、arachidonic acid 幾乎平坦、collagen 僅微弱反應；「只對 ristocetin 有反應、其他促效劑都不凝集」是 Glanzmann 血小板無力症的典型模式。
features: Channel 1, ristocetin 1.2 mg/mL: rapid, full aggregation curve with maximal amplitude 104%
Channel 2, low-dose ristocetin 0.6 mg/mL: no aggregation (1%), excluding type 2B VWD/platelet-type VWD hyper-responsiveness
Arachidonic acid 0%, epinephrine 1%, ADP 10%: essentially flat tracings with only shape-change deflection
Collagen: slow, reduced response reaching about 30% maximal aggregation
Pattern of absent aggregation to multiple agonists with preserved ristocetin agglutination
62891.describe_en: This figure shows light transmission platelet aggregometry tracings with the corresponding summary table. High-dose ristocetin (1.2 mg/mL) produces complete agglutination with a maximal amplitude of 104%, whereas low-dose ristocetin (0.6 mg/mL) shows no response. Arachidonic acid, epinephrine, and ADP produce essentially no aggregation (0 to 10%), and collagen gives only a slow, markedly reduced response (about 30%). Absent aggregation to physiologic agonists with preserved ristocetin-induced agglutination indicates a defect of the fibrinogen receptor, and in conjunction with a normal platelet count, normal VWF studies, and prolonged PFA closure times, the findings are consistent with Glanzmann thrombasthenia (integrin αIIbβ3 deficiency).

ddx.vs: Shows the opposite pattern: absent ristocetin agglutination with normal responses to ADP, collagen, epinephrine, and arachidonic acid, plus giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Reduced ristocetin response with normal aggregation to other agonists and abnormal VWF antigen/activity, whereas VWF levels here are normal to high.

ddx.dx: Aspirin/NSAID effect or storage pool/secretion defect
ddx.vs: Abolishes arachidonic acid response and the secondary wave to ADP/epinephrine but preserves primary wave aggregation to high-dose ADP, unlike the flat tracings here.
Also impairs aggregation, but plasma fibrinogen and coagulation times (PT/APTT) are markedly abnormal, whereas they are normal in this patient.

62763.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與切片中可見許多單葉圓核、核不分葉的巨核細胞（箭頭），這種 del(5q) 型巨核細胞形態，搭配核型分析在第 5 號染色體上的 inv(5)(q15q33) 異常，提示 5q 相關的骨髓增生不良症候群。
features: Megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or hypolobated single nuclei (arrows)
Megakaryocytes medium to large sized with abundant cytoplasm, scattered interstitially
Hypercellular marrow core with preserved trabeculae (low power)
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors; blasts not obviously increased
Karyotype with a structural abnormality of chromosome 5 labeled inv(5)(q15q33)
62763.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors and a megakaryocyte with a round, non-lobated nucleus (arrow). The core biopsy is hypercellular, and at high power several megakaryocytes with monolobated or hypolobated round nuclei are identified (arrows), without obvious increase in blasts. Karyotype analysis demonstrates an inversion of chromosome 5, designated inv(5)(q15q33). Findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic syndrome with del(5q)-type megakaryocytic morphology associated with a novel inv(5)(q15q33); blast enumeration and FISH/SNP array to assess 5q deletion or disruption are recommended.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, unlike the small round monolobated nuclei of 5q-type megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T shows ET-like hyperlobated megakaryocytes and ring sideroblasts rather than monolobated megakaryocytes.
Reactive megakaryocytes show normal lobation and no clonal cytogenetic abnormality.
CML megakaryocytes are small dwarf forms with hypolobated nuclei in a granulocytic hypercellular marrow and BCR::ABL1 is present.

62635.recognize_zh: 在顆粒球設門中，絕大多數細胞同時缺少 FLAER 與 CD24（GPI 錨定蛋白），落在左下框內，標示 PNH 顆粒球 97.03%，即為大型 PNH 克隆。
features: Gated on granulocytes: FLAER (x, log) versus CD24-PE (y, log)
Dominant population (arrow) negative for both FLAER and CD24, lower-left PNH gate
Small residual normal population double-positive (FLAER+ CD24 bright), upper right
Tiny FLAER+ CD24-dim cluster (likely eosinophils or partial events)
Event table: 41,526 of 42,797 granulocytes in PNH gate = 97.03%
62635.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood granulocytes displayed as FLAER versus CD24. The vast majority of granulocytes (41,526/42,797 events, 97.03%) show concurrent loss of FLAER binding and CD24 expression, falling in the PNH gate, while only a small residual population retains normal FLAER and CD24 expression. Loss of two independent GPI-linked markers on granulocytes identifies a GPI-deficient clone. Findings are consistent with a large paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) clone.

ddx.dx: Hereditary CD59 or isolated GPI-protein deficiency
ddx.vs: Inherited single-protein deficiencies affect one marker on all cells, whereas PNH shows loss of FLAER and multiple GPI-anchored proteins in a clonal subset.

ddx.dx: Immature/left-shifted myeloid cells in MDS or AML
ddx.vs: Immature granulocytes can be CD24-dim but still bind FLAER, so dual FLAER/CD24 loss favors a true PNH clone.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia with small PNH clone
ddx.vs: Many aplastic anemia patients carry small (<10%) clones; a 97% granulocyte clone indicates classic hemolytic PNH rather than a minor subclinical population.

62571.recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色：大量背景小 B 淋巴球呈強膜陽性，而散在成群、細胞質淡染的大型漿母細胞樣細胞為陰性，在棕色背景中形成「空洞」般的淡色區；大細胞不表現 CD20 是 germinotropic LPD（與 PEL）的典型表型。
features: Strong membranous CD20 staining in numerous small background B lymphocytes
Clusters of large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm are CD20 negative
Negative large-cell aggregates create pale 'holes' within the brown-staining follicular B-cell population
Endothelial-lined vessels and interstitial areas are negative
62571.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows strong membranous staining of numerous small B lymphocytes, while the admixed clusters of large atypical cells with abundant pale cytoplasm are negative, producing pale unstained aggregates within the CD20-positive background. Vessels and stromal cells are negative. Loss of pan-B-cell antigen expression by the large cells indicates a plasmablastic phenotype. Together with HHV8 LANA-1, EBER and MUM1 positivity, the findings are consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: In THRLBCL the scattered large cells are CD20 positive within a CD20-poor T-cell background, the opposite of this pattern.
NLPHL LP cells are CD20 positive and sit within nodules of small B cells, and are HHV8/EBV negative.
HRS cells are usually CD20 negative but are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and lack HHV8.

62507.recognize_zh: PAX5 染色中，骨髓幾乎全被強陽性的棕色細胞核佔滿，呈瀰漫片狀，只有少數陰性的間質細胞、血管與巨核細胞；表示大量 B 細胞瀰漫浸潤骨髓，符合 CLL 骨髓侵犯。
features: Diffuse sheets of cells with strong nuclear PAX5 positivity
Small, uniform round nuclei in positive cells
Scattered PAX5-negative stromal/endothelial cells and small vessels
Near-total replacement of marrow by B cells, with only rare negative hematopoietic cells
62507.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy stained for PAX5 shows diffuse sheets of small cells with strong nuclear positivity, replacing nearly all normal marrow elements. Only scattered stromal cells, vessels, and rare residual hematopoietic cells are negative. This pattern indicates extensive diffuse B-cell infiltration of the marrow. In the setting of a CD5/CD23-positive small lymphocytic infiltrate, the findings are consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: B-ALL is also PAX5-positive but shows blasts with fine chromatin that express TdT/CD34.
MCL is PAX5-positive as well and requires cyclin D1/SOX11 staining to distinguish it.
Plasma cells are typically PAX5-negative and CD138-positive, unlike this PAX5-positive infiltrate.

62443.recognize_zh: 低倍下大腸黏膜腺窩排列整齊、沒有扭曲，但腺窩之間的固有層被大量卵圓/梭形單核細胞撐開而顯得擁擠，表皮下方細胞更密集；這種「腺窩正常但固有層被均一細胞浸潤」的樣式需想到肥大細胞增生症並加做 CD117/CD25。
features: Colonic mucosa with regularly spaced, undistorted crypts and preserved goblet cells
Lamina propria expanded by a hypercellular infiltrate of small oval to spindle-shaped cells
Denser, band-like cellularity immediately beneath the surface epithelium
Infiltrating cells have pale eosinophilic cytoplasm; admixed eosinophils are only faintly appreciable at this power
No crypt abscesses, ulceration, basal plasmacytosis or granulomas in this field
62443.describe_en: Low-power view of a colonic mucosal biopsy (H&E) shows preserved crypt architecture without distortion or active cryptitis. The lamina propria is expanded by a hypercellular infiltrate of small oval to spindled cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, most dense in a subepithelial band, with admixed eosinophils. Because the infiltrating cells are bland and may be overlooked as stromal or inflammatory cells, immunostains for CD117, tryptase and CD25 are warranted. In context, findings are suggestive of mucosal involvement by mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: IBD shows crypt distortion, basal lymphoplasmacytosis and cryptitis, whereas crypts here are regular and the infiltrate is monotonous spindled cells.
Eosinophilic colitis expands the lamina propria with eosinophils without a population of pale spindled CD117/CD25-positive mast cells.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone or other low-grade lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma infiltrates consist of round small lymphoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and are CD20-positive rather than spindled tryptase-positive cells.
These bland spindle cell lesions entrap crypts but lack eosinophils and are S100 or EMA/claudin-1-positive and CD117-negative.

62379.recognize_zh: 這是全血球計數報告：血紅素 11.2 g/dL、MCV 77.6 fL、MCH 24.7 pg、MCHC 31.8 g/dL 皆偏低，而 RDW-CV 與 RDW-SD 顯示為星號（超出儀器可報告範圍），提示紅血球大小差異極大，與鐵劑治療中出現雙相族群（dimorphic）相符。
features: Mild anemia: HGB 11.2 g/dL with RBC 4.53 x10^6/uL
Low red cell indices: MCV 77.6 fL, MCH 24.7 pg, MCHC 31.8 g/dL (microcytic hypochromic)
RDW-CV and RDW-SD not reported (asterisks), indicating values beyond the analyzer's reportable range
Normal WBC 5.92 x10^3/uL with minimally high monocyte percentage (8.3%)
Platelets upper-normal (403 x10^3/uL) with high PCT and P-LCC
62379.describe_en: Complete blood count shows mild microcytic hypochromic anemia (hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL, MCV 77.6 fL, MCH 24.7 pg, MCHC 31.8 g/dL). The RDW-CV and RDW-SD fields are replaced by asterisks, indicating that red cell size heterogeneity exceeds the analyzer's reportable range (manually calculated RDW-SD 80.37 fL per history). The leukocyte count is normal with a borderline increased monocyte percentage, and the platelet count is at the upper limit of normal with increased plateletcrit. In a patient on iron therapy, these indices are consistent with treated iron deficiency producing a dimorphic red cell population; review of the RBC histogram and smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait shows microcytosis with a normal or high RBC count and a normal RDW, unlike the markedly elevated RDW here.
ACD is usually normocytic to mildly microcytic with normal RDW and high ferritin.
Sideroblastic anemia can also give a very high RDW with dimorphic cells but shows high ferritin and ring sideroblasts.

62315.recognize_zh: 這是熔解曲線（melting curve）分析圖：病人檢體除了約 65°C 的野生型峰外，另有約 59°C 的額外峰，而正常對照只有單一峰，代表偵測到 BRAF V600E 突變，支持毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）的診斷。
features: Derivative melting curve plot (-d(F2/F1)/dT versus temperature)
Normal control shows a single peak at approximately 64-65 C representing wild-type BRAF
Patient sample shows two peaks: an additional lower-temperature peak at approximately 59 C plus the wild-type peak
The lower-Tm peak reflects probe mismatch with the mutant allele, indicating BRAF V600E
62315.describe_en: The figure shows a real-time PCR melting curve analysis for the BRAF codon 600 region. The normal control demonstrates a single melting peak at approximately 64-65 C corresponding to the wild-type allele. The patient sample shows an additional peak at approximately 59 C in addition to the wild-type peak, indicating a heteroduplex/mismatch with the probe consistent with a BRAF V600E mutation. In the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context, this finding supports a diagnosis of hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: HCL-v is BRAF V600E wild-type (often MAP2K1 mutated), so it would show only the wild-type melting peak.
SMZL lacks BRAF V600E and would show a single wild-type peak.
Classic HCL expressing IGHV4-34 is often BRAF wild-type (MAP2K1 mutated), so a negative melt does not entirely exclude an HCL-like disorder.

62123.recognize_zh: 淋巴結極低倍全景可見多個反應性濾泡與生發中心，整體結構仍保存但變形，左上被膜纖維化中斷，淋巴組織延伸至周圍脂肪，是 Kimura 病低倍常見的表現。
features: Lymph node with overall preserved but distorted architecture
Numerous reactive follicles with variably sized germinal centers
Expanded, densely cellular interfollicular areas
Focal fibrosis and disruption of the capsule with lymphoid extension into perinodal adipose tissue
Magnification too low to assess eosinophils, deposits or microabscesses
62123.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows overall preserved but distorted architecture with numerous reactive follicles containing germinal centers of variable size and expanded, cellular interfollicular areas. Focal capsular fibrosis and disruption are present, with extension of the lymphoid infiltrate into the perinodal adipose tissue. Cytologic detail, eosinophils and germinal center deposits cannot be assessed at this magnification. The pattern is a nonspecific reactive follicular hyperplasia with perinodal extension, which in conjunction with high-power features of eosinophilic microabscesses and IgE deposits is consistent with Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows effaced architecture with back-to-back uniform follicles in and beyond the capsule and BCL2-positive germinal centers.
Ordinary reactive hyperplasia lacks eosinophilic microabscesses, germinal center IgE deposits and folliculolysis, which require high-power evaluation.
IgG4-related disease may have similar follicular hyperplasia and capsular fibrosis but shows increased IgG4-positive plasma cells rather than IgE deposits.
ALHE is a superficial dermal vascular proliferation with epithelioid endothelial cells rather than a deep lymph node-centered process.

62059.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色中倍下，背景小淋巴球大多陰性，陽性細胞呈瀰漫散佈而非結節聚集，其中不少為中空環狀的膜染色輪廓（大細胞或 rosettes），呈現 NLPHL 較瀰漫、T 細胞豐富的變異型態。
features: Diffusely scattered positive cells without nodular aggregation
Many ring-shaped membranous positive profiles with unstained centers, compatible with large positive cells or rosettes
Smaller positive cells interspersed between the ring profiles
Predominantly negative small lymphocyte background
Antibody identity not labeled; cytologic detail limited at this magnification
62059.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at medium power shows scattered positive cells distributed diffusely among a predominantly negative small lymphocyte background, without a nodular arrangement. Many positive profiles are ring-shaped with unstained centers, which may represent membranous staining of large cells or rosettes of positive small cells around unstained large cells; smaller positive cells are interspersed. Findings in a case of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma suggest a diffuse, T-cell-rich variant area; interpretation requires the marker identity and correlation with CD21 for residual follicular dendritic meshworks to separate it from T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL is separated by an entirely diffuse CD8+ T-cell background, few or no PD-1+ rosettes, and absence of CD21+ meshworks.
HRS cells in LRCHL are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5, whereas LP cells are CD20+/OCT2+ and CD30-/CD15-.
Reactive paracortex contains scattered immunoblasts within preserved nodal compartments without ringed large atypical cells effacing the node.

61995.recognize_zh: 左側低倍 H&E 可見腫瘤細胞在脂肪組織旁呈大片、結節狀浸潤；右側高倍為成片大型多形性細胞，核呈腎形或馬蹄形、有多顆有絲分裂，插圖中的馬蹄形核細胞即標誌細胞（hallmark cell），是退行性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）的形態特徵。
features: Low power: diffuse, vaguely nodular sheets of tumor cells replacing tissue adjacent to fat, with fibrous bands
High power: cohesive-appearing sheets of large pleomorphic cells with moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Kidney-shaped and horseshoe-shaped nuclei (hallmark cells), highlighted in the inset
Vesicular chromatin with multiple small nucleoli; frequent mitoses and apoptotic/pyknotic cells
Scant inflammatory background
61995.describe_en: H&E sections at low power show diffuse, vaguely nodular sheets of tumor cells effacing the tissue and abutting adipose tissue, with intervening fibrous bands. At high power, the infiltrate consists of large pleomorphic cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, including characteristic kidney- and horseshoe-shaped hallmark cells (inset). Mitotic figures and apoptotic cells are frequent. The morphology is consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; in the context of CD30+/ALK-negative immunophenotype, the referenced case represents TP63-rearranged ALK-negative ALCL.

ddx.vs: cHL shows Reed-Sternberg cells with large inclusion-like nucleoli, CD15 positivity and PAX5 dim expression, whereas ALCL hallmark cells are PAX5 negative with T-cell lineage.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: Anaplastic DLBCL expresses CD20/PAX5, which are negative in ALCL.
Cohesive sheets mimic carcinoma/melanoma; cytokeratin or S100/SOX10 positivity versus CD30 with T-cell/cytotoxic markers discriminates.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS shows variable, non-uniform CD30 and lacks the cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30.

61931.recognize_zh: CD3染色下，兩條被大型不規則核細胞塞滿的血管內，腫瘤細胞全為藍色陰性，只有血管周邊少數小型棕色T細胞呈陽性；以陽性小T細胞作為內在對照，確認腫瘤不是T細胞，搭配CD20陽性支持血管內大B細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Two vessels packed with large atypical cells that are CD3-negative (blue hematoxylin only)
Tumor nuclei are large with irregular, folded contours, vesicular chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Scattered small CD3-positive reactive T cells with brown membranous staining at the periphery of and around the vessels, serving as internal positive control
Adjacent brain parenchyma with CD3-negative glial nuclei and no extravascular tumor infiltrate
61931.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry on brain tissue shows two vessels distended by large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular vesicular nuclei that are negative for CD3. Rare small CD3-positive T cells are present at the periphery of the vessels and serve as an internal positive control. The surrounding parenchyma shows no CD3-positive infiltrate. The CD3-negative intravascular population, together with CD20 positivity, supports intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: In intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma the large intravascular cells express cytoplasmic CD3epsilon (often with CD56 and EBER), whereas here they are CD3-negative.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with reactive T cells
ddx.vs: Primary CNS DLBCL has a similar CD3-negative tumor with admixed reactive T cells but infiltrates the parenchyma in perivascular cuffs rather than staying intraluminal.
Intravascular myeloblasts are also CD3-negative but are CD20-negative and express myeloid markers such as MPO or CD33 with a high peripheral blast count.

61867.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中許多紅血球內有細小的環狀及梨形寄生蟲，部分紅血球含兩個以上蟲體，紅血球間散佈小型蟲體，紅血球大小正常且無瘧色素或配子體，符合巴貝西蟲（Babesia）感染。
features: Many red cells with small intraerythrocytic ring, dot and pyriform organisms
Several red cells containing two or more parasites
Small extracellular purple forms scattered between red cells (some likely platelets)
Infected red cells normal in size; no hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes
Tetrad forms not resolvable at this magnification
Occasional crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely artifactual
61867.describe_en: Giemsa-stained peripheral blood smear viewed at low magnification shows numerous red cells containing small ring, dot and pyriform intraerythrocytic organisms, with several red cells containing two or more parasites. Small extracellular purple forms are present between red cells, some of which are likely platelets. Infected red cells are not enlarged, and there is no hemozoin pigment, schizont or gametocyte formation; tetrads cannot be resolved at this power. Scattered crenated red cells are likely artifactual, and no leukocytes are present in this field. Findings are consistent with Babesia infection; high-power review for tetrads and PCR confirmation are recommended.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum rings are often double-chromatin or appliqué forms accompanied by banana-shaped gametocytes or pigment, without extracellular organisms or tetrads.
Superimposed platelets are granular with a surrounding clear halo and lie out of the red cell plane, rather than forming delicate rings within the cell.
Pappenheimer bodies are small clustered basophilic granules at the red cell periphery that are iron positive, not ring-shaped organisms.

61803.recognize_zh: 巨核細胞標記免疫染色中，中央一顆陽性巨核細胞含三個彼此分離的圓形小核，另有多顆小型、單核或低分葉的陽性巨核細胞散在，突顯巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Megakaryocyte-marker IHC with strong granular cytoplasmic brown staining
Central megakaryocyte with three widely separated round nuclei
Several small mononuclear or hypolobated positive megakaryocytes (micromegakaryocyte range)
Irregular positive cytoplasmic fragments and platelet aggregates in the background
Surrounding negative hematopoietic cells with round to oval nuclei
61803.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for a megakaryocytic marker (likely CD61 or CD42b; marker not labeled) on the bone marrow core highlights numerous megakaryocytes, including a form with three widely separated round nuclei and multiple small mononuclear or hypolobated megakaryocytes. Positive platelet aggregates and cytoplasmic fragments are scattered in the background. The stain accentuates dysplastic and small megakaryocytes that may be inconspicuous on H&E. Findings support megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes are large with lobulated, connected nuclei and lack separated nuclei or micromegakaryocytes.
AMKL shows sheets of CD61-positive blasts rather than scattered maturing dysplastic megakaryocytes.
MPN megakaryocytes are enlarged and hyperlobated or cloud-like, forming tight clusters, rather than small and multinucleated.

61739.recognize_zh: 高倍 CD20 染色可見許多大型、核呈泡狀的非典型細胞，細胞膜呈強棕色陽性，聚集在血管周圍，旁邊夾雜陰性的小淋巴球；大型 CD20 陽性 B 細胞是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫中的腫瘤細胞。
features: Numerous large atypical cells with strong, crisp membranous CD20 staining
Large vesicular nuclei with irregular contours among positive cells
Positive cells cluster around a small vessel
Admixed CD20-negative small lymphocytes, compatible with reactive T cells
61739.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry for CD20 highlights numerous large atypical cells with strong membranous staining, clustered around small vessels and admixed with CD20-negative small lymphocytes. The positive cells have large vesicular nuclei with irregular contours. The number of large B cells in this field is substantial. Together with EBER positivity, findings are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis with numerous large B cells (higher-grade pattern).

ddx.vs: DLBCL forms sheets of CD20-positive cells usually without angiocentric necrosis, a T-cell-rich background, or EBER positivity.
HRS cells are CD20-negative or weak/heterogeneous and CD30/CD15-positive, unlike the strong uniform CD20 here.
PMBL occurs in the anterior mediastinum with sclerosis and is CD23/MAL/PD-L1-positive and EBER-negative.

61675.recognize_zh: 視野中有兩顆小型淋巴球，核圓、染色質粗塊狀，其中一顆的細胞質下緣有一串清楚的小空泡；右上角另有一個被推擠拉長的破碎細胞（smudge cell），這兩個線索合起來支持帶空泡的 CLL 細胞。
features: Small mature-appearing lymphocytes with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and no visible nucleoli
Scant pale blue cytoplasm; the central cell shows a cluster of several small clear vacuoles at one pole
Smudge cell with streaming nuclear material at upper right
Background normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
61675.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. One lymphocyte contains a cluster of small, discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, and a smudge cell with streaming chromatin is present at the edge of the field. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with cytoplasmic vacuolation, in keeping with the stated CLL immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma cells tend to have more irregular nuclei and fewer smudge cells, and are separated definitively by cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and CD23 negativity.
Burkitt cells are larger with fine chromatin, nucleoli and intensely basophilic, heavily vacuolated cytoplasm, unlike these small clumped-chromatin cells.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated lymphocytes of lysosomal storage disease
