ddx.vs: Storage disease vacuoles appear in polyclonal lymphocytes of normal count in patients with systemic features, without smudge cells or a clonal CD5+/CD23+ population.
Splenic marginal zone lymphoma cells often have polar villous projections and more cytoplasm, and are usually CD5 and CD23 negative.

61611.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群芽細胞核大、染色質細緻，胞質淡藍含少量細顆粒，部分有核旁淡染區，旁邊可見分葉嗜中性球，符合伴有顆粒球分化的 AML；CEBPA 突變需分子檢測。
features: Cluster of large blasts with round to oval nuclei and high N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin with small nucleoli
Pale basophilic cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and occasional perinuclear clearing
Admixed mature segmented neutrophils and an eosinophil/granulated precursor
No Auer rod bundles or hypergranular promyelocytes in this field
61611.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules, some with a perinuclear hof. Admixed maturing and segmented neutrophils are present, indicating granulocytic maturation. Hypergranular promyelocytes and multiple Auer rods are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation; assignment to AML with mutated CEBPA requires molecular confirmation (in-frame bZIP mutation).

ddx.vs: t(8;21) blasts have more abundant cytoplasm with large salmon granules and slender Auer rods, often with dysplastic neutrophils; karyotype/FISH distinguishes.
NPM1-mutated AML frequently has cup-shaped nuclei and monocytic differentiation; ultimately separated by molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Regenerating marrow with promyelocyte left shift
ddx.vs: Recovering marrow shows a synchronized wave of promyelocytes/myelocytes with Golgi hofs and abundant granules, with <20% true blasts.

61547.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 EBER 原位雜交中，數個大型細胞核呈深藍色強陽性訊號，周圍小細胞為紅色對比染色陰性；陽性的是大型腫瘤細胞而非零星小淋巴球，支持 EBV 陽性 CHL。
features: Scattered large nuclei with strong dark blue nuclear EBER signal
Some positive nuclei lobated or paired, consistent with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells
Background small cells negative with pink nuclear fast red counterstain
Positive cells occur singly, not in sheets; bony trabecula at lower center
61547.describe_en: EBV-encoded RNA (EBER) in situ hybridization on a bone marrow biopsy shows strong nuclear signal in scattered large cells, some with lobated or paired nuclei, distributed singly within the infiltrate adjacent to a bony trabecula. The background small lymphocytes and stromal cells are negative. The positive cells correspond in size and distribution to the Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells seen on H&E and CD30 stains. Findings indicate EBV-positive classic Hodgkin lymphoma involving the marrow.

ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL shows numerous EBER+ large cells often in sheets that are CD20+ with strong PAX5, rather than scattered CD20−, CD15+ HRS cells.

ddx.dx: Latent EBV in bystander small B cells
ddx.vs: Bystander EBV-positive cells are rare, small lymphocytes, whereas here the signal is in large atypical nuclei.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma (e.g. AITL) with EBV+ B-immunoblasts
ddx.vs: AITL has EBER+ B immunoblasts of variable size amid a neoplastic CD10+/PD-1+ T-cell population with high endothelial venule proliferation.

61483.recognize_zh: 這是細胞遺傳學影像：一個經數位處理（去背景、增強對比）的中期分裂相，染色體延長且散開、帶紋清楚，是後續排列成核型圖之前的步驟，本身無法直接判讀異常。
features: Single GTG-banded metaphase spread after digital processing (background removed, contrast enhanced)
Chromosomes are relatively long and well spread with discernible light and dark bands, suitable for karyotyping
A few chromosomes overlap near the center, which must be separated during karyogram assembly
No numerical or structural abnormality can be reliably assessed before the chromosomes are arranged
61483.describe_en: This is a cytogenetic image rather than a morphologic smear, showing a single GTG-banded metaphase from a cultured bone marrow aspirate after digital processing to remove background and enhance banding. The chromosomes are well spread and elongated with visible banding, although some overlap centrally. Such processed metaphases are subsequently cut out and arranged into a karyogram by length, centromere position and banding pattern for counting and structural analysis. No abnormality can be interpreted from the unarranged spread alone.

61419.recognize_zh: 周邊血液（A–C）可見中小型異型淋巴球，核不規則、有凹陷或花瓣/腎形核（箭頭），組織切片（D）為中小型細胞瀰漫浸潤，免疫染色（E、F）呈強陽性，符合以白血病表現的 ALK 陽性 ALCL 小細胞變異型。面板未標註抗體名稱。
features: Peripheral blood with circulating small to medium atypical lymphoid cells (A-C)
Irregular, indented, reniform or cloverleaf-like nuclei with condensed chromatin; arrows highlight nuclear notching/indentation
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm in some cells; occasional smudged cell and platelet clump
Tissue section (D): diffuse infiltrate of predominantly small to medium cells
IHC (E): strong cytoplasmic/membranous staining in many cells, accentuated in larger cells; (F): diffuse nuclear staining in most cells (antibodies not labeled)
61419.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears show circulating small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to reniform or flower-like nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm. The accompanying tissue section shows a diffuse infiltrate composed predominantly of small to medium cells rather than sheets of large anaplastic cells. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong cytoplasmic/membranous reactivity in the infiltrate and a diffuse nuclear stain in most cells; the specific antibodies are not labeled in this figure. In the stated context, findings are consistent with the small cell variant of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma with leukemic presentation.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are HTLV-1 associated and CD25+ but ALK-negative and usually CD30 weak or negative in small cells.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclei and are CD4+ CD7-/CD26- without ALK expression or CD30 in larger perivascular cells.
T-PLL cells have a prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs and show TCL1A overexpression without ALK.
PTCL-NOS lacks ALK and the perivascular CD30+ ALK+ large hallmark cells of the small cell variant.

61355.recognize_zh: 兩顆中型淋巴細胞的核為卵圓形、染色質細緻均勻，細胞質淡藍灰色，周緣佈滿細長的毛狀突起（circumferential hairy projections），是毛狀細胞白血病的典型毛狀細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, slightly larger than small lymphocytes
Oval to round, slightly indented nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed (ground-glass) chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with low to moderate N:C ratio
Fine, hair-like cytoplasmic projections around the entire cell circumference
Background erythrocytes with a polychromatic cell; no granulocytes or monocytes in field
61355.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. Monocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia, which is confirmed by flow cytometry (bright CD20, CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123, annexin A1) and BRAF V600E mutation.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: Cells have a distinct nucleolus, often leukocytosis without monocytopenia, and are CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E negative.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar (bipolar) projections and more clumped chromatin, and are usually CD103 and CD25 negative.
LGLs have smooth cytoplasmic borders with coarse azurophilic granules rather than circumferential hair-like projections.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm, and are CD14 positive.

61227.recognize_zh: CD4 染色下，瀰漫浸潤的淋巴瘤細胞大多為陰性，只有零星散佈的組織球與背景 T 細胞呈棕色陽性，表示腫瘤細胞失去 CD4 表現。
features: Diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the mucosa with residual glands at the left edge
The vast majority of infiltrating cells are CD4 negative
Scattered positive cells with dendritic or histiocytic shapes and occasional small positive lymphocytes serve as internal control
Glandular epithelium negative; faint background staining only
61227.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD4 on the mucosal biopsy shows that the diffuse infiltrate of lymphoid cells is predominantly negative. Scattered positive histiocytes and occasional background T cells provide an internal positive control. Together with negativity for CD20, CD5, CD7 and CD8, and positivity for CD3, CD56 and EBER, the immunoprofile is consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS is usually CD4 positive with retained or partially lost pan-T antigens and is EBER negative in tumor cells.
BPDCN is CD4+, CD56+ and CD123+ with blastic morphology and is CD3 and EBER negative.
Reactive infiltrates contain abundant CD4-positive helper T cells rather than a CD4-negative sheet.

61163.recognize_zh: 透過目鏡拍攝的低倍血液抹片中，紅血球之間有一條細長、呈彎曲鉤狀、染成紫色的線狀蟲體，長度相當於數十個紅血球，即為微絲蚴（microfilaria）。
features: Single elongated, slender, coiled/hook-shaped worm many red-cell diameters long lying among red cells
Purple-staining body with a column of nuclei suggested but not individually resolved at this magnification
Tapering tail at one end and a curved looped anterior portion
Sheath, cephalic space and tail-tip nuclei cannot be assessed at this low magnification
Background red cells without obvious intraerythrocytic parasites
61163.describe_en: Low-power photomicrograph of a peripheral blood smear, taken through the eyepiece, shows a single elongated, coiled, purple-staining nematode larva measuring many red-cell diameters in length, lying among red cells. The body tapers toward one end; sheath characteristics and the arrangement of tail nuclei cannot be evaluated at this magnification. No other parasites are identified in the field. Findings are consistent with microfilaremia; species identification requires high-power examination of the sheath and tail nuclei (e.g., Wuchereria bancrofti versus Brugia malayi) on a Giemsa-stained thick film, ideally collected at night.

ddx.dx: Wuchereria bancrofti vs Brugia malayi vs Loa loa
ddx.vs: Separation relies on high-power features: W. bancrofti is sheathed with a nucleus-free tail tip, Brugia has two separate terminal tail nuclei, and Loa loa has nuclei extending to the tail tip.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller, unsheathed and have a blunt tail with nuclei to the tip.
Artifacts are refractile, of uniform thickness without tapering ends or internal nuclear column.
Trypanosomes are only about 2-3 red cells long with an undulating membrane, flagellum and kinetoplast.

61099.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見大量嗜酸性白血球（A），骨髓抹片則在嗜酸性白血球之間混有高核質比、細染色質的淋巴母細胞（B），切片免疫染色瀰漫陽性（C），核型圖以箭頭標示 5 號與 14 號染色體異常（D）；嗜酸性白血球增多合併 B-ALL 時應想到 t(5;14) IL3-IGH。
features: Peripheral blood: marked eosinophilia with mature eosinophils showing coarse orange-red granules and bilobed nuclei
Bone marrow aspirate: population of blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors admixed with the blasts (eosinophils themselves not morphologically dysplastic)
Core biopsy immunostain: diffuse strong staining of densely packed neoplastic cells (antigen not labeled)
Karyotype with arrows marking abnormal chromosomes 5 and 14 (plus an additional arrowed chromosome), consistent with t(5;14)(q31;q32)
61099.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear shows marked eosinophilia composed of mature-appearing eosinophils without circulating blasts in this field. The bone marrow aspirate shows lymphoblasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, admixed with eosinophils. An immunostain on the core biopsy shows diffuse positivity in a densely cellular infiltrate, and the G-banded karyogram highlights rearranged chromosomes 5 and 14. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with t(5;14)(q31;q32); IL3::IGH, in which reactive eosinophilia may precede or overshadow the blast population.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: In these neoplasms the eosinophils are part of the clone and blasts, if present, may be T- or myeloid lineage, whereas in t(5;14) B-ALL the eosinophils are reactive (non-clonal) and the IL3::IGH fusion is detected by karyotype/FISH.
Reactive eosinophilia lacks a marrow lymphoblast population and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Inv(16) AML shows abnormal eosinophil precursors with large basophilic granules and myelomonocytic MPO+ blasts rather than TdT+ CD19+ lymphoblasts.
CEL shows clonal dysplastic eosinophils and increased myeloblasts without a B-lymphoblast population.

61035.recognize_zh: CD20 染色下 B 細胞沒有形成正常濾泡，只沿著血管或被膜呈帶狀分布（箭頭），並有散在大型 B 免疫母細胞；CD3 則染出大量胞質透明、核不規則的 T 細胞，這種 B 細胞被推擠、T 細胞主導的模式符合 AITL。
features: Low-power CD20: no well-formed follicles; B cells arranged in linear bands along vessels/capsule (arrows) and scattered throughout
High-power CD20: scattered small and larger B cells including immunoblast-like cells, with CD20-negative clear cells in between
CD3: diffuse membranous positivity in most cells, including medium-to-large cells with clear cytoplasm and irregular nuclei (arrows)
T cells predominate over B cells in the infiltrate
61035.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains on lymph node show loss of normal follicular architecture. CD20 highlights B cells distributed in linear bands along vascular or capsular structures and as scattered small and large B cells, including immunoblast-like forms, whereas the intervening infiltrate is CD20-negative. CD3 stains the majority of cells, including medium-to-large atypical T cells with clear cytoplasm and irregular nuclei. This pattern of T-cell predominance with dispersed, displaced B cells and scattered B immunoblasts is consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: In TCRBCL the large atypical cells are CD20+ while the background T cells are small and non-atypical, the reverse of this pattern.
Reactive nodes retain discrete CD20+ primary/secondary follicles and CD3+ T cells are small and non-atypical.
A secondary B-cell lymphoma would show confluent sheets of large CD20+ cells rather than scattered B immunoblasts.

60971.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以有核紅血球為主，可見多顆核碎裂、核出芽與巨母紅血球樣染色質的異常紅血球前驅細胞（黑箭頭），同時散在核染色質細、細胞質少量嗜鹼性的母細胞（白箭頭），符合紅血球系為主的 MDS 伴母細胞增多（MDS-EB-2）。
features: Erythroid-predominant aspirate with numerous erythroid precursors at various stages
Marked dyserythropoiesis: karyorrhexis, nuclear budding/fragmentation and megaloblastoid nuclear chromatin (black arrows)
Scattered blasts with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and a rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm (white arrows)
Occasional erythroid precursor with vacuolated or pale cytoplasm; binucleate/lobulated erythroid forms
Panel B: dysplastic erythroid cell with abundant cytoplasm and fragmented, multilobated nucleus
60971.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid predominance with marked dyserythropoiesis, including megaloblastoid maturation, karyorrhexis, nuclear budding and multilobated nuclei. Scattered myeloblasts with fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm are increased. Blast enumeration must be performed on all nucleated marrow cells: blasts account for 15% of total nucleated cells (38% of non-erythroid cells). Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts-2, erythroid-predominant (formerly acute erythroid leukemia, erythroid/myeloid type, under WHO 2008).

ddx.dx: Pure erythroid leukemia (AML with erythroid differentiation)
ddx.vs: Requires >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, whereas here maturing erythroid precursors predominate and blasts are myeloid.
Shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes but no increase in CD34-positive myeloblasts and corrects with vitamin replacement.
Requires ≥20% blasts of all nucleated marrow cells under WHO 2016 (the denominator excludes no lineage), which is not met here.
Dysplasia is reversible, with no increased blasts or clonal complex karyotype.

60907.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑增厚不規則，骨小樑旁為纖維化基質且造血細胞稀少，高倍可見骨表面成排的造骨細胞與多核蝕骨細胞；流式圖中標示的 CD56 陽性、高散射「osteoblasts」族群，結合腎病背景提示腎性骨病變（副甲狀腺機能亢進）造成的繼發性骨髓纖維化。
features: PB: normocytic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and an occasional polychromatic cell (arrow), neutrophils present
BM biopsy low power: thickened, irregular, scalloped bony trabeculae with paratrabecular and intertrabecular fibrosis and reduced hematopoiesis
High power: rimming of bone surfaces by plump osteoblasts (green arrow) and osteoclastic activity (blue arrow) within fibrous stroma
Aspirate inset: osteoblast with eccentric nucleus and abundant blue cytoplasm with pale area away from the nucleus
Flow cytometry: cluster labeled osteoblasts with high scatter and CD56 expression, CD45 negative
60907.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisopoikilocytosis with an occasional polychromatophilic red cell. The bone marrow core biopsy demonstrates thickened, irregular bony trabeculae with scalloped surfaces, prominent paratrabecular fibrosis and diminished hematopoietic tissue. At higher power, bone surfaces are lined by activated osteoblasts with associated osteoclasts, reflecting increased bone remodeling, and osteoblasts are also seen on the aspirate. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-negative, CD56-positive population with high scatter consistent with osteoblasts rather than neoplastic cells. Findings are consistent with secondary myelofibrosis due to renal osteodystrophy (osteitis fibrosa related to hyperparathyroidism).

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, whereas here fibrosis is paratrabecular with osteoblast/osteoclast activation and no megakaryocytic atypia.
Metastatic tumor forms cohesive keratin-positive clusters, while the CD56-positive cells here are osteoblasts lining bone.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with CD56 expression
ddx.vs: Myeloma cells are CD38/CD138 bright with light-chain restriction, whereas osteoblasts are CD45 negative, CD38 negative/dim and rim trabeculae.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines and giant osteoclasts without the renal/hyperparathyroid clinical context.

60843.recognize_zh: 腹水細胞離心抹片中多數嗜中性白血球的核失去分葉絲、濃縮成數個圓形深染的核碎塊，胞質淡染但仍保持完整細胞邊界，屬於凋亡（apoptotic）嗜中性球。
features: Cytospin preparation of body fluid with numerous neutrophils on a clean background
Nuclei condensed into two to four smooth, round, dense, separated lobes lacking chromatin filaments (pyknotic/apoptotic)
Some cells show tiny dark karyorrhectic fragments
Cytoplasm preserved, pale-pink to grayish with intact cell membranes
Scattered macrophages/mesothelial-type cells with larger irregular nuclei and bluish vacuolated cytoplasm
60843.describe_en: Cytocentrifuged ascitic fluid shows a neutrophil-predominant cellularity with scattered macrophages. Many neutrophils display apoptotic change, with nuclei condensed into round, smooth, homogeneously dark fragments that have lost their connecting filaments, while the cytoplasm and cell membranes remain intact. Some cells contain small karyorrhectic nuclear particles. No organisms or malignant cells are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with apoptotic (necrobiotic) neutrophils, an in vitro/in vivo ageing artifact that should not be mistaken for nucleated red cells or atypical cells.

ddx.vs: NRBCs have a single round dense nucleus with hemoglobinized cytoplasm, whereas apoptotic neutrophils show multiple round nuclear fragments in granular neutrophil cytoplasm.
An LE cell contains a large homogeneous glassy phagocytosed nuclear mass that pushes the neutrophil nucleus aside, not multiple small condensed lobes.
Hypersegmented neutrophils retain lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments with open lobar chromatin, not smooth pyknotic spheres.
Lymphocytes have one round nucleus with scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm rather than several separated dense spheres.

60779.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球系前驅細胞比例偏高，可見晚期正染紅血球母細胞呈雙核（兩顆等大濃縮核，如下方中央）及成對相連的中期紅血球母細胞，提示晚期紅血球母細胞多核化的先天性紅血球生成異常貧血第二型（CDA II）。
features: Cellular aspirate with numerous erythroid precursors at intermediate and late stages (round nuclei, clumped chromatin, blue to grey-pink cytoplasm)
Binucleate late erythroblasts with two equal-sized condensed nuclei (bottom center) and closely paired erythroblasts
Occasional erythroblast with irregular/lobulated nucleus
Maturing myeloid cells present (myelocyte, band and segmented neutrophil) and a large macrophage with granular debris-laden cytoplasm
Multinucleation in this single field is limited; the full binucleate/multinucleate frequency cannot be judged from one view
60779.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with prominent erythroid precursors, including intermediate and late erythroblasts. Several late erythroblasts are binucleate with two equal-sized condensed nuclei, and occasional erythroblasts show irregular nuclear contours. Granulocytic maturation is present, and a macrophage with granular cytoplasmic debris is seen, consistent with ineffective erythropoiesis. Findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II (HEMPAS) in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation relies on SEC23B sequencing, band 3 hypoglycosylation (SDS-PAGE) or electron microscopy showing peripheral double membranes.

ddx.vs: Shows internuclear chromatin bridges between erythroblasts and spongy 'Swiss cheese' heterochromatin on electron microscopy, with binucleated cells less prominent than in type II.
Occurs in older adults with multilineage dysplasia, ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities rather than a lifelong inherited anemia.
Erythroblasts show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin, and hypersegmented neutrophils and giant metamyelocytes are present.
Features giant multinucleated erythroblasts with up to 12 nuclei and autosomal dominant KIF23 mutation, rather than predominantly binucleate late forms.

60587.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 淋巴組織中有數個結節狀區域，被周圍小淋巴球包覆；核染色的免疫染色只在其中兩個結節呈幾乎全部細胞核強陽性，其他結節與背景僅散在陽性，提示濾泡內（被「包覆」的）高增生性病灶，如 Burkitt 淋巴瘤。此放大倍率下星空樣（starry sky）巨噬細胞無法清楚辨認。
features: Low-power lymphoid tissue with multiple vague nodules separated by sheets of small lymphocytes
Nodules composed of densely packed cells; tingible-body macrophages suggested as scattered pale spots but not resolvable at this magnification
Nuclear immunostain (likely Ki-67 or MYC; not labeled) with near-100% strong nuclear positivity confined to two well-circumscribed nodules
Other nodules and interfollicular areas show only scattered positive nuclei
Sharp demarcation between positive nodules and surrounding negative lymphoid cells (mantle-like cuff)
60587.describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows lymphoid tissue with multiple ill-defined nodules surrounded by small lymphocytes, without obvious diffuse effacement at this magnification. A nuclear immunostain highlights two sharply circumscribed nodules with near-uniform strong nuclear positivity, whereas the remaining nodules and interfollicular regions show only scattered positive nuclei. The starry-sky pattern cannot be assessed at this resolution, and the antibody is not labeled; high-power morphology, MYC FISH and a complete B-cell phenotype (CD10, BCL6, BCL2 negative) are required. In the stated context, findings are suggestive of Burkitt lymphoma with a follicular/nodular (in situ-like) distribution cloaked within otherwise preserved lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarized, moderate-to-high Ki-67 with tingible-body macrophages in all follicles and are BCL2 negative without MYC rearrangement, rather than near-100% staining restricted to select nodules.
Neoplastic follicles are usually BCL2 positive, back-to-back and show lower, non-polarized proliferation with BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Morphology may overlap; FISH demonstrating concurrent BCL2 rearrangement discriminates it from Burkitt lymphoma.
DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic with variable Ki-67 and usually lack the IG::MYC translocation as the sole driver.

60587.stain: H&E; IHC: nuclear marker (likely Ki-67, not labeled)

60651.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量異常前骨髓細胞（promyelocyte），胞質充滿粗大紫紅顆粒，部分細胞內含成束交錯的針狀 Auer 小體（faggot cell），核圓或雙葉狀；這種形態即使 PML::RARA FISH 陰性仍強烈提示急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）。
features: Predominance of abnormal promyelocytes with round to reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, and visible nucleoli
Abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules, some obscuring the nucleus
Faggot cells containing bundles of numerous crisscrossing needle-like Auer rods (panels A and B)
Some hypogranular cells with basophilic cytoplasm and folded or bilobed nuclei (panel C)
Scarce maturing granulocytes and a single background nucleated red cell
60651.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with round to folded nuclei, fine chromatin, and abundant cytoplasm filled with coarse azurophilic granules. Several cells contain bundles of numerous needle-like Auer rods (faggot cells), and occasional cells show bilobed nuclei with less granular cytoplasm. Normal granulocytic maturation beyond the promyelocyte stage is markedly reduced. The morphology is characteristic of acute promyelocytic leukemia; a negative PML::RARA FISH result should prompt RT-PCR or sequencing for a cryptic/submicroscopic PML::RARA insertion or a variant RARA fusion. Note that the assigned category (EBV-positive T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder) does not correspond to this image.

ddx.vs: Non-APL AML shows blasts with single Auer rods and fewer granules, without sheets of hypergranular promyelocytes or faggot cells.

ddx.dx: APL with variant RARA fusion (e.g., ZBTB16::RARA)
ddx.vs: ZBTB16::RARA cases have more regular nuclei, fewer Auer rods, and pseudo-Pelger cells and are ATRA-resistant, so molecular testing beyond PML::RARA FISH is required.
Regenerating marrow has orderly maturation with a Golgi hof in promyelocytes and never contains Auer rods.
Monocytic cells have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and folded nuclei, are nonspecific esterase positive, and lack bundles of Auer rods.

60715.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片背景散佈多根淡紫色、邊緣筆直的長桿狀／長方形結晶，長度遠超過紅血球直徑且位於細胞外，周圍紅血球聚集，為冷凝球蛋白（cryoglobulin）在抹片上析出的結晶。
features: Multiple extracellular, elongated rod-shaped to rectangular crystalline structures with straight parallel edges
Crystals homogeneous and pale lavender-purple, several times the length of a red cell
Red cells clumped and partially crenated around the crystals; others unremarkable
No intracellular inclusions; few platelets and no leukocytes in this field
60715.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous extracellular, homogeneous, pale purple rod-shaped crystals with sharp straight edges, measuring several red cell diameters in length, lying between clumped and crenated red cells. There are no intracellular crystalline inclusions in leukocytes within this field. In the appropriate clinical setting, these precipitates are consistent with cryoglobulin crystals formed as the sample cooled; warming the specimen to 37°C, cryoglobulin quantification and investigation for an underlying monoclonal gammopathy or lymphoproliferative disorder are recommended.

ddx.vs: HbC crystals are intraerythrocytic, dense, dark orange-red and hexagonal or bar-shaped within a red cell membrane, rather than pale extracellular rods.
Stain precipitate forms irregular dark granular deposits in different focal planes, lacking uniform geometric rods.
Cold agglutinins cause red cell agglutinates without crystals, and cryofibrinogen precipitates in plasma but not serum, requiring laboratory confirmation.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are slender bipyramidal hexagonal needles associated with eosinophil degranulation, usually in tissue or fluids rather than blood films.

60523.recognize_zh: IgG4 免疫染色下，強陽性的漿細胞集中分布在一個淋巴濾泡（生發中心）內，周圍套區的小淋巴球則為陰性，呈現「濾泡內 IgG4+ 漿細胞」型態；確診仍需計數每高倍視野數量與 IgG4/IgG 比例。
features: Numerous strongly IgG4-positive plasma cells clustered within a germinal center
Positive cells show cytoplasmic staining with eccentric round nuclei
Surrounding mantle-zone small lymphocytes are negative
Few IgG4-positive cells outside the follicle in this field
Density appears to approach or exceed ~100 positive cells per high-power field focally, but quantitation and IgG ratio cannot be determined from this single image
60523.describe_en: IgG4 immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows a reactive follicle containing numerous strongly IgG4-positive plasma cells within the germinal center, with only rare positive cells in the surrounding mantle zone and interfollicular area. The IgG4-positive plasma cells have abundant cytoplasmic staining and eccentric nuclei. This intrafollicular pattern is characteristic of the follicular hyperplasia (progressive transformation/reactive follicular) pattern of IgG4-related lymphadenopathy; diagnosis requires >100 IgG4+ plasma cells/HPF and an IgG4+/IgG+ ratio >40% together with clinical and serologic correlation, since increased IgG4+ plasma cells are non-specific.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with non-specific IgG4+ plasma cells
ddx.vs: Many reactive nodes contain IgG4+ plasma cells, and only an IgG4/IgG ratio >40% with >100/HPF plus clinical context supports IgG4-related disease.
Castleman disease shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells with regressed follicles, often elevated IL-6/CRP, and may also have raised IgG4+ cells, requiring clinical exclusion.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows light-chain restricted (monotypic kappa or lambda) plasma cells and follicular colonization, whereas IgG4-related plasma cells are polytypic.
Rosai-Dorfman shows sinus expansion by S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis, although IgG4+ plasma cells may be increased.

60459.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結完全被單調一致的小淋巴樣細胞瀰漫取代，看不到濾泡、竇或殘存正常結構，只有散在細小玻璃樣小血管與零星淡染組織細胞，符合被套細胞淋巴瘤的瀰漫生長型。
features: Complete effacement of nodal architecture by a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate
Monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells without follicles or sinuses
Scattered small hyalinized vessels throughout
Scattered pale histiocytes imparting a subtle mottled appearance
No proliferation centers or starry-sky pattern at this magnification
60459.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows complete effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells. No residual follicles, sinuses, or proliferation centers are identified. Scattered small hyalinized vessels and pale histiocytes are distributed throughout. Findings are suggestive of a low-grade B-cell lymphoma and, in conjunction with CD5 and cyclin D1 positivity, are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: SLL shows pale proliferation centers with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is LEF1/CD23 positive and cyclin D1 negative.
FL shows centrocytes and centroblasts, CD10/BCL6 positivity, and residual CD21 meshworks.
Lymphoblasts have fine blastic chromatin, a high mitotic rate, and TdT expression.

60267.recognize_zh: 紅血球在分散區域仍排成4–6顆一列、邊緣重疊的錢串狀（rouleaux），而非不規則團塊；此外可見少數淚滴形紅血球，整體符合骨髓瘤中蛋白質增加所致的錢串形成。
features: Red cells overlapping in linear stacks of 4-6 cells, arranged like stacked coins
Rouleaux present in areas where adjacent red cells are otherwise separated
Red cells normochromic with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional teardrop-shaped forms
No leukocytes in field; few small platelets
60267.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous short and intermediate linear stacks of red cells in the thin portion of the smear, consistent with rouleaux formation. Individual red cells are normochromic with mild poikilocytosis, including rare dacrocytes. No leukocytes or circulating plasma cells are present in this field, and irregular agglutinates are not seen. Findings are consistent with rouleaux formation, as seen with a paraprotein in plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Agglutinates are irregular clusters without linear orientation and are temperature-dependent.
Overlap in thick areas is haphazard and involves the whole field, whereas rouleaux form linear stacks in thin areas with intervening clear spaces.
Rouleaux can be morphologically identical, so SPEP/immunofixation and marrow evaluation are needed to establish a paraprotein.

60139.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央是一顆雙葉核的嗜酸性球，其胞質中的橘紅色顆粒偏少且分布不均、夾雜淡灰藍區域；紅血球大致正常。單一視野無法確立嗜酸性球增多，需結合血球計數與PDGFRA基因檢測。
features: Single eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus with two round, symmetric lobes
Orange-red granules relatively sparse and unevenly distributed with pale agranular areas (mild hypogranulation)
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis; one polychromatic red cell
Scattered normal-appearing platelets; no blasts in this low-power field
60139.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus and relatively sparse, unevenly distributed eosinophilic granules with pale agranular cytoplasmic areas. The red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis and an occasional polychromatic cell, and platelets appear adequate in number and morphology. No blasts are seen in this field. A single field cannot establish marked eosinophilia; however, in conjunction with the reported marked eosinophilia with abnormal granulation and segmentation and FIP1L1::PDGFRA fusion, the findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can show the same mild hypogranulation, so separation depends on clinical workup for secondary causes and absence of PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangements.
Idiopathic HES has persistent eosinophilia with end-organ damage but no identifiable clonal genetic abnormality or aberrant T-cell population.
Basophils have coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus rather than orange-red refractile granules.

60075.recognize_zh: 視野中央是一個邊界不清、細胞質破碎的巨噬細胞，內含許多藍黑至藍綠色粗顆粒（含鐵血黃素 hemosiderin），並夾雜被吞噬或黏附的核碎片與細胞；周圍有分葉嗜中性球與含顆粒的前驅細胞。在 Diamond-Blackfan anemia（常反覆輸血）骨髓中，含鐵血黃素巨噬細胞增加反映鐵過量。
features: Central macrophage with ill-defined, disrupted cytoplasm containing coarse blue-black to blue-green granular pigment (hemosiderin)
Engulfed or adherent nuclear debris and cells within the macrophage cluster
Surrounding myeloid cells: segmented neutrophils, a myelocyte, and a granulated precursor with coarse reddish granules (likely eosinophil precursor)
Small lymphocyte adjacent to the macrophage
No erythroid precursors in this field; red cells show brown staining artifact
60075.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with ill-defined, partially disrupted cytoplasm containing abundant coarse blue-black to blue-green granular pigment consistent with hemosiderin, together with engulfed or adherent nuclear debris. Surrounding cells include segmented neutrophils, myelocytes, a coarsely granulated eosinophil precursor, and a small lymphocyte, while erythroid precursors are not seen in this field. The pigment identity should be confirmed with a Prussian blue stain. Findings are consistent with hemosiderin-laden macrophages, in keeping with increased storage iron, which in Diamond-Blackfan anemia commonly reflects transfusional iron overload.

ddx.vs: Show striated or foamy cytoplasm with sea-blue granules that are Prussian blue negative, in contrast to coarse iron-positive hemosiderin granules.
Macrophages contain intact engulfed red cells, nucleated cells, or platelets in increased numbers with a compatible clinical syndrome, rather than predominantly hemosiderin pigment.
Have dark metachromatic granules within an intact cell with a distinct nucleus, whereas this is a large histiocyte with pigment and debris.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and background in random distribution and is not confined to a macrophage; Prussian blue confirms true iron.

60011.recognize_zh: 單一巨核細胞具有豐富的顆粒狀細胞質，但細胞核分成三個彼此完全分離的圓形核，沒有核絲相連；這種「分離核葉」巨核細胞是骨髓發育不良中巨核系發育不良的代表型態。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant granular lilac cytoplasm
Three discrete, widely separated round to kidney-shaped nuclei without connecting chromatin
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Platelet granules dispersed into surrounding background
Isolated cell; other lineages and blast count not assessable in this field
60011.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm containing three widely separated, discrete nuclei with no visible chromatin bridges. Platelet-type granules are scattered around the cell. This separated-lobe (multinucleated) morphology is a recognized form of dysmegakaryopoiesis. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia, supporting acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes when blasts are 20% or more.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain many uniform round nuclei, often more than five, each with a nucleolus, and do not shed platelets.
Normal megakaryocytes have lobes connected into a single nuclear mass rather than fully separated nuclei.
Micromegakaryocytes are small, promyelocyte-sized cells with a single hypolobated nucleus, unlike this large multinucleated cell.

30315.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中兩個有核紅血球之間以細長染色質橋（internuclear bridging，箭頭）相連，另可見雙核有核紅血球與核低分葉、顆粒減少的嗜中性球，加上淚滴細胞，屬於多系發育不良的線索，符合 MDS 伴多系發育不良。
features: Panel A: two adjacent nucleated red cells with dense round nuclei connected by a thin chromatin bridge (arrow)
Panel B: binucleated nucleated red cell with two round dense nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm
Panel B: neutrophil with hypolobated, band-like nucleus and reduced granulation (pseudo-Pelger-Huet-like/hypogranular)
Panel B: nucleated red cell with irregular nuclear budding/bridging (arrow)
Red cell anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes and an echinocyte
30315.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows circulating nucleated red cells with dysplastic features, including internuclear chromatin bridging between two erythroid nuclei (A, arrow), a binucleated form and nuclear budding (B). A hypolobated, hypogranular neutrophil is also present, and red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes. Blasts are not seen in these fields. Findings are consistent with multilineage dysplasia, supporting myelodysplastic syndrome with multilineage dysplasia; bone marrow examination with blast count and cytogenetics is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia produces nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils rather than hypolobated hypogranular neutrophils, and corrects with B12/folate.
CDA I shows internuclear bridges confined to the erythroid lineage in a young patient without granulocytic dysplasia.
PMF shows a leukoerythroblastic picture with numerous teardrop cells and a fibrotic marrow, while dysplastic bridging is not a characteristic feature.

ddx.dx: Drug or toxin-induced dysplasia (e.g., chemotherapy, copper deficiency)
ddx.vs: Secondary dysplasia has an identifiable exposure or deficiency and resolves after its removal, typically with ring sideroblasts and vacuolated precursors in copper deficiency.

28139.recognize_zh: 移植後病人雙側足背、腳踝及小腿出現對稱的紅色斑疹／麻疹樣（morbilliform）皮疹，於足背與腳趾處融合成片——肢端（手掌、腳掌、足背）受侵犯是急性移植物抗宿主病（acute GVHD）皮膚表現的常見分布。
features: Symmetric erythematous macular to morbilliform eruption on both distal legs, ankles and dorsal feet
Small discrete macules on the shins becoming confluent erythema over the dorsal feet and toes
Acral accentuation of erythema
No bullae, erosions, sclerosis or lichenoid papules visible
Nails and toes otherwise unremarkable
28139.describe_en: Clinical photograph of both lower legs and feet shows a symmetric erythematous macular to morbilliform eruption involving the shins and ankles, becoming confluent over the dorsal feet and toes. There are no visible bullae, erosions, sclerotic plaques or lichenoid lesions. In a post-allogeneic transplant setting, the acral-predominant morbilliform rash is consistent with cutaneous acute graft-versus-host disease; a skin biopsy (interface dermatitis with basal vacuolization and apoptotic keratinocytes) and exclusion of drug and viral causes are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Drug eruptions typically begin on the trunk with a temporal link to a new drug and show eosinophils on biopsy, whereas GVHD favors acral sites, ears and face with basal apoptotic keratinocytes.
Occurs around neutrophil recovery with fever, capillary leak and pulmonary infiltrates, and resolves quickly with brief steroids.
Requires viral PCR in blood or tissue; histology lacks the prominent satellite cell necrosis of GVHD.
Vasculitis produces palpable purpura that does not blanch, unlike the blanching macular erythema here.

4843.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球胞質內有多顆鮮亮藍綠色、邊界清楚且具折光性的圓形包涵體（green neutrophil inclusions），和一般嗜中性顆粒或 Döhle 小體明顯不同；這類「綠色死亡結晶」常見於急性肝衰竭或乳酸中毒，提示預後不良。
features: Segmented neutrophil with several discrete bright blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions
Inclusions round, sharply defined and larger than normal neutrophilic granules
Background neutrophilic granulation otherwise present; no Döhle bodies or vacuolation
Surrounding red cells normocytic with one cell showing a refractile drying artifact
4843.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing multiple discrete, round, bright blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions, distinct from normal specific granules. No Döhle bodies or intracellular organisms are identified. Red cells show no specific abnormality apart from a drying artifact. In a patient with liver disease, findings are consistent with green neutrophil inclusions (so-called crystals of death), thought to represent lipofuscin-like biliverdin-derived material, associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and high short-term mortality.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue, poorly demarcated, non-refractile patches of rough endoplasmic reticulum at the cell periphery.
Toxic granules are fine, dark purple, evenly distributed azurophilic granules rather than a few large bright green refractile bodies.
Malaria pigment is brown-black and bacteria are basophilic rods or cocci, neither with the bright green color.
Chédiak-Higashi granules are giant purple-red azurophilic granules present in most granulocytes, not green refractile inclusions.

18539.recognize_zh: 兩個嗜中性球的細胞膜外緣整圈黏附著一顆顆血小板，形成像花環的血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism），背景游離血小板很少；血小板被困在白血球周圍，使自動計數機低估血小板（假性血小板減少）。
features: Two segmented neutrophils each rimmed by a ring of adherent platelets (rosettes)
Platelets of normal size and granulation attached to the neutrophil membrane
Few free-lying platelets in the background
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without fragments
No platelet clumps elsewhere in this field
18539.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two segmented neutrophils surrounded by rosettes of normal-sized, well-granulated platelets adhering to their cell membranes, with relatively few free platelets in the background. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that causes spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts; a repeat platelet count in citrate-anticoagulated blood or from a fingerstick smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumping forms free-standing aggregates of platelets rather than rosettes around neutrophils, although the two may coexist.
True thrombocytopenia shows uniformly few platelets without satellitism or clumping, and the count does not correct in citrate.
Phagocytosed material lies within cytoplasmic vacuoles, whereas satellite platelets sit on the outer cell surface.

21099.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中大量標靶細胞（target cells）與摺疊、不規則收縮的紅血球，並可見紅血球內呈深紅色棒狀、六角形的 HbC 結晶（像金條），沒有鐮刀狀細胞，符合同合子血紅素 C 病。
features: Numerous target cells (codocytes) throughout the field
Intraerythrocytic dense, dark red rod-shaped to hexagonal HbC crystals with parallel sides
Folded and irregularly contracted red cells and some microspherocytes
Absence of classic sickle cells
Scattered platelets; no nucleated red cells in this field
21099.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a prominent population of target cells together with folded, irregularly contracted and spherocytic erythrocytes. Several red cells contain dense, dark-staining, straight-edged rod or hexagonal crystals with the red cell membrane closely applied, characteristic of hemoglobin C crystals. Sickled cells are not identified. Findings are consistent with homozygous hemoglobin C disease; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is recommended.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows irregular crystals with blunt finger-like projections ('Washington monument' or 'glove' forms) and occasional sickle cells.
HbSS shows many elongated sickle cells and Howell-Jolly bodies rather than tetragonal crystals.

ddx.dx: Thalassemia or liver disease with target cells
ddx.vs: Target cells in thalassemia are accompanied by microcytosis and basophilic stippling, and in liver disease by acanthocytes, without HbC crystals.
HbC trait has fewer target cells, no anemia and rarely shows crystals, and HPLC shows about 40% HbC with HbA.

18091.recognize_zh: 這是長條圖而非形態圖：橫軸為 CLL 一線治療方案（chlorambucil、fludarabine、alemtuzumab、FC、FCR、FCM、RFCM），縱軸為病人百分比；藍色為 CR、綠色疊加為 MRD 陰性 CR，含 rituximab 的化學免疫療法 CR 與 MRD- 比例最高。
features: Stacked bar graph, not a morphologic image
Y-axis: percent of patients (0-90%)
Blue bars: complete response; green segments: MRD-negative CR
Chlorambucil and fludarabine monotherapy show low CR rates without reported MRD-negative CR
FCR, FCM and RFCM show the largest MRD-negative CR fractions (RFCM total about 80%)
18091.describe_en: This stacked bar graph (Ghia, Hematology 2012) summarizes rates of complete response (blue) and MRD-negative complete response (green) after first-line therapy in CLL across trials. Response rates rise progressively from chlorambucil and fludarabine monotherapy through alemtuzumab and fludarabine-cyclophosphamide (FC) to chemoimmunotherapy regimens (FCR, FCM, RFCM), in which MRD-negative CR accounts for a substantial proportion of patients. The figure illustrates that more intensive and antibody-containing regimens achieve deeper responses, supporting MRD as a treatment endpoint. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.

17579.recognize_zh: A 為骨髓抹片中成片中至大型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質深藍並有多個清楚的空泡（Burkitt 樣外觀）；B 為複雜核型與 FISH（BCL6、MYC、BCL2 分離探針及 IGH/MYC 融合），提示 MYC 合併 BCL2 和/或 BCL6 重排的高惡度 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: sheet of medium-to-large lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and relatively fine chromatin
Panel A: moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous small, sharply defined clear vacuoles
Panel A: scattered erythroid cells and a single plasma/lymphoid cell among the tumor cells
Panel B: G-banded karyogram with multiple structural abnormalities (complex karyotype)
Panel B: metaphase FISH images labeled BCL6, MYC, CEP8/MYC/IGH and BCL2, indicating rearrangement studies
17579.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate (panel A) shows sheets of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with round nuclei, relatively fine chromatin and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous small, well-demarcated lipid-type vacuoles, admixed with occasional erythroid precursors. Panel B shows a complex karyotype with metaphase FISH using BCL6, MYC, IGH/MYC and BCL2 probes. The Burkitt-like cytology is not specific, and classification depends on the genetic studies. Findings are consistent with a high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangements (double-/triple-hit) involving the marrow.

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma has similar vacuolated basophilic cells but typically carries an isolated IG::MYC translocation with a simple karyotype, BCL2-negative immunophenotype and no BCL2 rearrangement.
DLBCL cells are usually larger and more pleomorphic, and lack concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements on FISH.
Lymphoblasts have finer chromatin, scant cytoplasm and are TdT/CD34-positive and surface immunoglobulin-negative.
Plasmablastic cells have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof and are CD20-negative, CD138/MUM1-positive.

15147.recognize_zh: A、B 圖為真性紅血球增多症（PV）骨髓：明顯增生、三系皆增加（panmyelosis），巨核細胞大小不一且散在或鬆散成群；C、D 圖為 PV 後骨髓纖維化：造血細胞減少、巨核細胞核深染不規則成群，嗜銀纖維染色見粗大纖維與骨硬化。
features: A: markedly hypercellular marrow with panmyelosis and increased, pleomorphic megakaryocytes including large hyperlobated forms, loosely clustered
B: immunostain with red chromogen highlighting abundant (likely erythroid) precursors, with unstained megakaryocytes and fat
C: post-PV myelofibrosis with fibrotic stroma, reduced hematopoiesis, streaming and clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei
D: silver impregnation showing dense coarse reticulin/collagen fibers (grade 2-3) with thickened, sclerotic bone trabeculae (orange)
Dilated sinusoids and loss of fat in fibrotic phase
15147.describe_en: Composite bone marrow biopsies. In the polycythemic phase (A), the marrow is hypercellular for age with trilineage proliferation (panmyelosis), prominent erythropoiesis and increased megakaryocytes of variable size, including large hyperlobated forms in loose clusters; an immunostain with red chromogen (B) highlights the expanded hematopoietic, likely erythroid, compartment. In post-polycythemic myelofibrosis (C), hematopoiesis is reduced and replaced by fibrotic stroma containing clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei, and the silver stain (D) shows dense, coarse reticulin/collagen fibrosis with osteosclerotic trabeculae. Findings are consistent with polycythemia vera (A, B) progressing to post-PV myelofibrosis (C, D).

ddx.vs: Prefibrotic PMF shows granulocytic rather than erythroid predominance with bulbous, hyperchromatic megakaryocytes in dense clusters, and overt PMF lacks a prior history of documented PV with erythrocytosis.
ET marrow is normocellular with isolated proliferation of large to giant megakaryocytes with staghorn nuclei and no panmyelosis.
Secondary erythrocytosis shows erythroid hyperplasia without megakaryocytic pleomorphism or clustering, with normal to high EPO and no JAK2 mutation.

ddx.dx: Myelofibrosis secondary to metastatic carcinoma or other causes
ddx.vs: Secondary fibrosis contains the causative tumor or process (keratin-positive cells, granulomas) and lacks atypical MPN-type megakaryocyte clusters.

15147.stain: H&E (A, C); IHC red chromogen (B); silver/reticulin (D)
captions: A: Hypercellular PV marrow with panmyelosis and pleomorphic megakaryocytes
B: Immunostain highlighting expanded hematopoietic precursors
C: Post-PV myelofibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters in fibrotic stroma
D: Silver stain showing dense fibrosis and osteosclerosis

10219.recognize_zh: 腦組織 H&E 可見血管周圍與腦實質內瀰漫浸潤的大型異型淋巴細胞，核大、不規則、染色質空泡狀並有明顯核仁，背景有空泡化神經膠質與凋亡碎片，在器官移植病人符合單形性 PTLD（瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤型）。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate of large atypical lymphoid cells replacing brain parenchyma
Large irregular to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli
Infiltrate surrounds and involves the wall of a small blood vessel (angiocentric pattern)
Scattered apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures
Vacuolated neuropil background with admixed smaller lymphocytes
10219.describe_en: Brain biopsy shows brain parenchyma diffusely infiltrated by sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with an angiocentric distribution around and within the wall of a small vessel. The cells have large, irregular vesicular nuclei with conspicuous nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, accompanied by mitotic figures and apoptotic debris in a vacuolated neuropil background. No well-formed glial neoplasm is present. In a solid organ transplant recipient, and with the reported CD20/PAX5-positive, MUM1/BCL2-positive, CD10-negative, EBER-positive phenotype, findings are consistent with monomorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, diffuse large B-cell lymphoma type.

ddx.vs: Polymorphic PTLD shows a full range of B-cell maturation including small lymphocytes, plasma cells and immunoblasts, whereas monomorphic PTLD consists of sheets of large transformed cells meeting lymphoma criteria.
Glioblastoma shows GFAP-positive pleomorphic glial cells with microvascular proliferation and pseudopalisading necrosis, while this infiltrate is CD45/CD20 positive lymphoid cells.
Infectious encephalitis shows a mixed inflammatory infiltrate with necrosis and identifiable organisms, lacking sheets of atypical EBER-positive large B cells.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS lymphoma in immunocompetent host
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; the transplant history and EBV positivity define PTLD, whereas immunocompetent PCNSL is usually EBV-negative.

5675.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群大型、細胞質豐富的非造血細胞聚集成團，細胞質內及背景散布大量粗大的黑褐色色素顆粒（melanin），部分細胞幾乎被色素塞滿，符合轉移性惡性黑色素瘤。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with abundant pink-purple finely granular cytoplasm
Coarse black-brown pigment granules within cytoplasm, heavily obscuring some cells
Nuclei largely obscured by pigment and cytoplasm; nuclear detail limited
Free extracellular pigment granules scattered in the background
No normal hematopoietic cells in this field
5675.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with abundant pink-purple, finely granular cytoplasm. Many cells contain coarse black-brown pigment granules, and several are so heavily pigmented that nuclear detail is obscured; free pigment granules are also seen in the background. Normal hematopoietic elements are not present in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic malignant melanoma involving the marrow; immunohistochemistry for SOX10, S100 and Melan-A/HMB-45 on the biopsy can confirm.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is golden-brown to blue-black on Wright stain, occurs in scattered single macrophages, and is Prussian blue positive, whereas this pigment is in cohesive tumor-cell clusters and Prussian blue negative.
Mast cells are single round cells packed with uniform purple metachromatic granules and a visible central nucleus, not cohesive clusters with coarse brown-black pigment.
Carcinoma clusters show cohesion and nuclear molding without melanin and are keratin positive.
Stain precipitate lies on top of cells and background in a random distribution and is not confined to the cytoplasm of a cohesive cell group.

1323.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中倍切片中，一大片由嗜酸性白血球密集組成的鮮紅色區域（eosinophilic microabscess）位於濾泡間區，旁邊有淡色生發中心與小血管增生，是木村病淋巴結的典型組合。
features: Large sheet-like aggregate of eosinophils with bright red granular cytoplasm forming an eosinophilic microabscess
Adjacent reactive follicle with a pale germinal center (upper left)
Interfollicular areas with small lymphocytes and increased small vessels/high endothelial venules
No large atypical or Reed-Sternberg-like cells evident
Mixed background of lymphocytes and plasma cells
1323.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a large, dense aggregate of eosinophils forming an eosinophilic microabscess in the interfollicular region. Adjacent areas show a reactive follicle with a pale germinal center and interfollicular small lymphocytes with increased small vessels. No large atypical cells are identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Kimura lymphadenopathy in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: cHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, which are not evident among the eosinophils here.
ALHE is a vascular proliferation lined by epithelioid endothelial cells in skin/subcutis, rather than nodal follicular hyperplasia with eosinophil abscesses.
LCH eosinophilic abscesses are accompanied by sinusoidal Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei positive for CD1a and langerin.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells with effacement and aberrant phenotype rather than preserved reactive follicles.

1195.recognize_zh: 這是胸水流式細胞圖：高 FSC 的大細胞閘門（B）中，91.1% 事件表現 kappa、僅 3.6% 表現 lambda，呈 kappa 輕鏈限制（light chain restriction），且 CD19 在一半 kappa+ 細胞中偏弱/陰性，支持單株性大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: FS vs SS plot: a distinct population with high forward scatter (large cells, gate B) separate from small red lymphocytes
CD45 vs SS: gated events are CD45-positive with variable side scatter, confirming hematolymphoid cells
Kappa vs lambda on large-cell gate: 91.1% kappa-positive versus 3.6% lambda-positive (kappa restriction)
Kappa vs CD19: 48.5% kappa+/CD19+ with an additional 47.2% kappa+ events that are CD19-dim to negative
Non-morphologic figure; no cytologic detail
1195.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the pleural fluid shows a population of large cells with high forward scatter that are CD45-positive. Within the large-cell gate, surface light-chain analysis shows marked kappa predominance (91.1% kappa versus 3.6% lambda), indicating a monotypic B-cell population. CD19 is expressed on approximately half of the kappa-positive events, with the remainder CD19-dim to negative, which may reflect aberrant CD19 loss or nonspecific kappa binding by Fc receptor-bearing macrophages and should be correlated with CD20/CD22 gating. Findings are consistent with a kappa-restricted large B-cell lymphoma involving the pleural effusion.

ddx.vs: Reactive B cells show a kappa:lambda ratio of roughly 0.5-3:1, not the ~25:1 skew seen here.
PEL typically lacks CD19/CD20 and surface immunoglobulin and expresses CD138/CD38 with HHV8 positivity, rather than a surface kappa-restricted CD19+ population.

Macrophages bind light-chain antibodies nonspecifically via Fc receptors and are CD19-negative, high side scatter and CD14/CD64-positive, so the CD19-negative kappa+ events must be excluded by lineage gating.

1259.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中，陰性小淋巴球背景裡有成群及散在的大型細胞呈強棕色細胞質陽性，細胞明顯大於周圍細胞，此分布符合黑色素細胞標記（如 Melan-A/HMB45/S100）凸顯轉移的黑色素瘤細胞。
features: Clusters and scattered single large cells with strong brown cytoplasmic staining
Positive cells are 2-3 times larger than the surrounding negative small cells
Some positive cells show granular or dark, pigment-like cytoplasmic staining
Positive cells arranged in irregular groups and streaks rather than diffuse sheets
Background of densely packed negative small round cells
1259.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows clusters and scattered single large cells with strong cytoplasmic positivity in a background of negative small round cells. The positive cells are considerably larger than the background cells and form irregular aggregates and streaks. The specific antibody is not stated, but the cytoplasmic pattern is compatible with a melanocytic marker such as Melan-A, HMB45 or S100; intrinsic melanin pigment should not be mistaken for chromogen. Findings support involvement by metastatic melanoma.

ddx.vs: Melanin-laden macrophages appear brown on any stain, so a red chromogen or SOX10 nuclear staining is needed to separate true melanocytic positivity.
Carcinoma clusters would be keratin-positive and negative for melanocytic markers.
ALCL large cells are CD30/ALK-positive and often sinusoidal, and negative for melanocytic markers.
Clear cell sarcoma also expresses melanocytic markers but is a soft-tissue primary with EWSR1::ATF1 fusion rather than a metastasis from a cutaneous melanoma.

1067.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中散佈多個紅血球碎片，包括頭盔細胞（helmet cell）、三角形與不規則小碎片（schistocytes），而血小板數量看起來並未明顯減少，符合人工主動脈瓣造成的機械性溶血。
features: Numerous red cell fragments (schistocytes): helmet cells, triangular and irregular angular fragments
Microspherocytes/small dense fragments scattered among normocytic red cells
Occasional polychromatophilic red cell
Platelets present and not obviously decreased
No leukocyte abnormality in this field
1067.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells and small triangular and irregular red cell fragments, among otherwise normocytic red cells with occasional polychromasia. Platelets appear present in adequate numbers in this field. Findings are consistent with fragmentation (microangiopathic-pattern) hemolytic anemia; in a patient with a malfunctioning prosthetic aortic valve, this represents mechanical valve-related hemolysis, but thrombotic microangiopathy should be excluded clinically (platelet count, ADAMTS13, renal function).

ddx.vs: TTP shows schistocytes with marked thrombocytopenia and severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity, whereas valve hemolysis typically has preserved platelets.
DIC shows schistocytes with thrombocytopenia plus prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer.
Oxidative hemolysis (e.g., G6PD deficiency) shows bite and blister cells with Heinz bodies on supravital stain rather than sharply angular fragments.
Hereditary spherocytosis and warm AIHA show round spherocytes lacking angular fragments, with DAT or EMA binding testing for separation.

4203.recognize_zh: 脾臟低倍H&E中紅髓被大量淋巴樣細胞瀰漫浸潤而擴張，左上方只剩一個小的白髓淋巴鞘，細胞組成混雜不單一，符合傳染性單核球增多症造成的紅髓擴張。
features: Diffuse expansion of the red pulp by a dense lymphoid infiltrate
Polymorphous cell population including small lymphocytes and larger cells with more cytoplasm
Small residual white pulp nodule around an arteriole (upper left)
Arterioles and vascular structures preserved
No discrete monomorphic nodules or necrosis at this power
4203.describe_en: Section of spleen at low power shows marked expansion of the red pulp by a dense, diffuse lymphoid infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes admixed with larger activated cells. White pulp is relatively inconspicuous, with a small residual periarteriolar lymphoid sheath at the upper left. No monomorphic nodules or necrosis are evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the red pulp lymphoid expansion of infectious mononucleosis; correlation with higher-power morphology and EBER is advised to exclude lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows monotonous sheets of large atypical B-cells effacing architecture, whereas this infiltrate is polymorphous.
HSTL shows monotonous medium-sized cells within red pulp sinusoids with white pulp atrophy and a gamma-delta T-cell phenotype.
CLL infiltrates are composed of monotonous small round lymphocytes with proliferation centers rather than a mixed activated population.

4075.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中央有一顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色並呈細纖維條紋狀，像揉皺的衛生紙（crumpled tissue paper），細胞核小而偏位，是 Gaucher 細胞的典型特徵。
features: Large histiocyte many times the size of surrounding myeloid cells
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine fibrillary, striated (crumpled tissue paper) texture
Small, eccentric, inconspicuous nucleus
Cytoplasm lacks discrete vacuoles or foamy bubbles
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes
4075.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm having a fine fibrillary, wrinkled texture and a small eccentric nucleus, set among maturing granulocytic and lymphoid cells. The cytoplasm is striated rather than vacuolated. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look identical and are distinguished by normal glucocerebrosidase activity and the underlying disease.
Niemann-Pick cells have soap-bubble vacuolated foamy cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules rather than fine linear striations.

3947.recognize_zh: 高倍下異常早幼粒細胞的細胞質內可見多根細長的 Auer 小體聚集成束，另一顆細胞帶有細緻的嗜天青顆粒；多根 Auer 小體是急性前骨髓細胞白血病的重要線索。
features: Large abnormal promyelocyte with nucleus partly obscured by granules
Multiple slender Auer rods clustered in the cytoplasm
Fine, dusty azurophilic granules rather than coarse granulation
Second abnormal cell with irregular outline and fine granules
Background normochromic red cells
3947.describe_en: High-power view of the peripheral blood shows a large abnormal promyelocyte whose cytoplasm contains multiple slender Auer rods arranged in small bundles along with fine azurophilic granules partially overlying the nucleus. An adjacent smaller cell shows fine cytoplasmic granulation and an irregular outline. The presence of multiple Auer rods in cells with relatively fine granulation is suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular variant; PML::RARA confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Non-APL AML usually shows single Auer rods in blasts with round nuclei, whereas multiple rods in bundles in promyelocyte-like cells favor APL.
Myelomonocytic blasts have grey-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles and NSE positivity, and bundles of Auer rods are uncommon.
Reactive neutrophils are mature segmented cells with coarse dark granules and pale blue Döhle bodies, not rod-shaped inclusions in immature cells.

3883.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被一群單調的中大型母細胞佔滿，細胞核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少且無顆粒、看不到 Auer 小體，外觀類似淋巴母細胞，必須靠流式細胞儀證實髓系標記才能診斷為微分化型 AML。
features: Sheets of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei, some with slight indentation
Fine, finely dispersed chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
No Auer rods identified
Few residual small lymphocytes, normoblasts and a neutrophil
3883.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular and replaced by sheets of monotonous medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not seen, and residual normal hematopoiesis is scant. Morphologically the blasts are undifferentiated and cannot be distinguished from lymphoblasts. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia; the diagnosis of AML with minimal differentiation requires MPO cytochemistry positivity in fewer than 3% of blasts with myeloid markers (CD13, CD33, CD117) on flow cytometry and absence of lymphoid-specific markers.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts look identical; they are distinguished by flow cytometry showing CD19/CD79a/CD22 or cytoplasmic CD3 rather than CD13/CD33/CD117 expression.
AML without maturation has at least 3% MPO-positive blasts and may show granules or Auer rods.
MPAL requires lineage-specific markers of more than one lineage (e.g., MPO plus cytoplasmic CD3 or strong CD19), determined only by immunophenotyping.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61 positive on flow cytometry.

3691.recognize_zh: 中性球很多（像濃縮白血球層抹片），箭頭指的兩顆中性球裡各有一顆均質、淡紫色的大圓形物（LE body），把本身分葉核推到旁邊；在一群中性球中找到這種細胞，就是 LE 細胞。
features: Increased neutrophils, in keeping with a buffy-coat/LE cell preparation
Two neutrophils (arrows) containing a large round homogeneous pale-purple inclusion without chromatin structure
Neutrophil nuclear lobes compressed to the cell periphery around the inclusion
Other neutrophils show normal lobation and granulation
Crenated RBCs in background
3691.describe_en: Low-power view of a leukocyte-rich smear shows numerous segmented neutrophils. Two neutrophils (arrows) each contain a large, round, homogeneous pale-purple inclusion that lacks chromatin pattern and pushes the phagocyte's nucleus to the periphery. The remaining neutrophils are unremarkable, and the red cells show crenation. Findings are consistent with LE cells.

ddx.vs: Tart cells contain an engulfed nucleus that keeps chromatin texture, usually inside a monocyte, rather than a structureless homogeneous body.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil phagocytosing an RBC or apoptotic cell
ddx.vs: Engulfed RBCs are pink-orange and apoptotic bodies are small, dark, and pyknotic, unlike the large pale-purple glassy LE body.
Overlapping cells have separate cell membranes and retained nuclear chromatin, not an inclusion within a single neutrophil cytoplasm.

3563.recognize_zh: 右下方細胞的核分成數個緊密排列的葉，呈苜蓿葉或花瓣狀（flower-like），染色質深、細胞質淡藍而幾乎無顆粒，旁邊有一顆正常小淋巴球可比較大小；這種花瓣狀核提示成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤。
features: Lymphoid cell with polylobated, clover-leaf/flower-like nucleus with compact lobes
Dense chromatin without nucleoli
Pale-blue, essentially agranular cytoplasm, unlike neutrophil cytoplasm
Normal small lymphocyte (upper left) with round nucleus and scant deep-blue cytoplasm for size comparison
Normochromic RBCs; occasional platelets
3563.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphoid cell with a polylobated, flower-like nucleus, dense chromatin, and pale, largely agranular cytoplasm, adjacent to a normal small lymphocyte. The lobes are compact rather than joined by thin filaments, and the cytoplasm lacks neutrophilic granules. Red cells are unremarkable. In an HTLV-1-seropositive patient, findings are consistent with an ATLL flower cell, here in the smoldering variant.

ddx.vs: Neutrophil lobes are joined by thin filaments and the cytoplasm is pink with fine granules, whereas flower-cell cytoplasm is pale blue and agranular.
Sézary cells have finely grooved cerebriform nuclei rather than compact petal-like lobes and are HTLV-1-negative.
Dysplastic neutrophils show granulocytic cytoplasm and are MPO-positive, while ATLL cells are CD4+CD25+ T cells.

3371.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央有十餘顆成熟中性球聚集成團（neutrophil aggregation），另有多處大片不規則的紅血球凝集塊與小球形紅血球；中性球被聚集時儀器計數會偏低，造成假性中性球低下。
features: Large cluster of about 15 mature segmented neutrophils aggregated together
Additional small groups of 2-3 neutrophils nearby
Irregular large clumps of agglutinated red cells throughout the field
Many small dense spherocytes/microspherocytes among individual red cells
Occasional echinocyte; individual neutrophils morphologically unremarkable
3371.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large aggregate of approximately 15 mature segmented neutrophils, along with smaller neutrophil clusters. The background contains numerous irregular clumps of agglutinated red cells and many small dense spherocytes, consistent with the stated Coombs-positive immune hemolytic anemia. The neutrophils themselves appear morphologically normal without blasts or dysplasia. Findings are consistent with in vitro neutrophil aggregation causing spurious (pseudo)neutropenia on automated counts; a manual differential, a smear from a non-EDTA or warmed sample, and review of the analyzer flags are recommended.

ddx.vs: True neutropenia shows few neutrophils evenly distributed on the smear without clumps, and counts remain low in citrate or warmed samples.
Platelet clumps are aggregates of small anucleate granular fragments, not nucleated segmented neutrophils.
Rouleaux are orderly stacks of red cells like coins, whereas agglutination forms irregular three-dimensional clumps as seen here.

ddx.dx: Circulating tumor or leukemic cell cluster
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters contain large atypical cells with high N:C ratio and nucleoli, while this cluster is composed of normal mature neutrophils.

3307.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆白血球的核邊緣呈鋸齒、缺角，染色質粗糙並有不規則透亮小洞，像被老鼠啃過（rodent cell）；周圍紅血球普遍皺縮成棘狀，提示檢體久置或乾燥造成的退化假影。
features: Single leukocyte with an irregular, notched 'gnawed' nuclear contour
Coarse, clumped chromatin with irregular clear spaces giving a moth-eaten appearance
Scant, indistinct cytoplasm
Diffuse red cell crenation (echinocytic change) in the background
Adjacent smudged, pale degenerating cell fragment below the leukocyte
3307.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single leukocyte with an irregular, notched nuclear outline and coarse chromatin interrupted by clear punched-out spaces, imparting a 'nibbled' or moth-eaten appearance, with scant indistinct cytoplasm. The surrounding red cells show diffuse crenation, and a smudged degenerating cell is present nearby. These changes are consistent with in vitro degenerative (storage/drying) artifact producing a so-called rodent cell, and should not be interpreted as a neoplastic or dysplastic change.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have convoluted, folded nuclei with smooth grooves and intact chromatin, not jagged notches with punched-out holes.
Apoptotic cells show dense homogeneous pyknotic or fragmented nuclear bodies with condensed eosinophilic cytoplasm rather than a notched, vacuolated nucleus.
Dysplastic neutrophils retain granulated cytoplasm and a smooth nuclear contour with hypolobation, and are seen in fresh well-prepared films.
ATLL flower cells show multilobated petal-like nuclei with condensed chromatin in fresh smears, not an eroded outline accompanied by diffuse red cell crenation.

3179.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆中型淋巴細胞的核有多處深凹、形成數個指狀／花瓣狀分葉，染色質濃縮，細胞質少而淡藍，符合 ATLL 的 flower cell 形態。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell, slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Nucleus with several deep indentations forming finger-like lobes (cloverleaf/flower pattern)
Condensed, dark chromatin without distinct nucleoli
Scant pale-blue cytoplasm with a thin darker rim
Background normocytic red cells, occasional crenated cell and small platelets
3179.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized atypical lymphoid cell with a deeply indented, multilobated nucleus forming finger-like lobes, condensed chromatin and scant pale-blue cytoplasm. Red cells are largely normocytic with an occasional crenated form, and scattered platelets are present. The nuclear configuration is characteristic of flower cells. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; HTLV-1 serology and T-cell immunophenotyping are recommended.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells show a finely grooved cerebriform nucleus rather than discrete deep lobes and occur in HTLV-1-negative patients with erythroderma.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with nuclear clefting
ddx.vs: CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like chromatin and are CD5+ CD23+ B cells, with only occasional minor notches.
Hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential hairy projections, not a lobulated nucleus with scant cytoplasm.
Neutrophils show granular pink cytoplasm and very coarse chromatin lobes joined by filaments.

3115.recognize_zh: 三顆單核球系細胞：左側細胞核分葉摺疊、胞質豐富灰藍；中間細胞胞質布滿細小嗜天青顆粒；右側核呈腎形。周邊血中出現多顆型態不一的單核球，符合CMML的單核球增多。
features: Three monocytic cells in peripheral blood
Left cell with lobulated, convoluted nucleus and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Central cell with oval nucleus and cytoplasm dusted with fine azurophilic granules (immature monocyte/promonocyte versus granulocytic precursor)
Right cell with reniform nucleus and pale gray cytoplasm
Red cell with small dark inclusion at right (Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer body)
3115.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three monocytic cells with abnormal features. One has a lobulated, convoluted nucleus with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, another has an oval nucleus with finely granular cytoplasm, and a third has a reniform nucleus with pale gray cytoplasm. A red cell contains a small dark inclusion. Findings are consistent with monocytosis with atypical monocytes, as seen in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (persistent monocytes at least 0.5 x 10^9/L and at least 10% of leukocytes).

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are uniform and mature without dysplasia in other lineages, and monocyte flow partitioning shows fewer than 94% classical monocytes.
AML shows at least 20% blasts plus promonocytes with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli.
Myelocytes have round nuclei with coarser chromatin and pink secondary granules without the folded nuclei of monocytes; nonspecific esterase can help.

3051.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一小群小型成熟淋巴球，核染色質濃密成塊、核上有明顯的裂溝或切口（clefted nuclei），細胞質少量淡藍，這種核裂淋巴球增多是百日咳（pertussis）淋巴球增多症的典型表現。
features: Cluster of small mature lymphocytes, slightly larger than RBCs
High N:C ratio with scant pale to moderately blue cytoplasm
Nuclei with distinct clefts, notches, or folds (clefted/cleaved lymphocytes)
Condensed, clumped mature chromatin without visible nucleoli
Background RBCs and platelets unremarkable; no blasts or atypical large cells
3051.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small aggregate of mature lymphocytes. The cells are small, with scant pale blue cytoplasm and condensed, clumped chromatin; several nuclei show deep clefts or notches. No nucleoli, blasts, or reactive immunoblasts are seen, and the red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. In a child with paroxysmal cough, this absolute lymphocytosis of small clefted lymphocytes is suggestive of Bordetella pertussis infection.

ddx.vs: Buttock cells of follicular lymphoma occur in adults and are CD10+/BCL2+ clonal B cells, whereas pertussis lymphocytes are polyclonal, predominantly T cells in children.
CLL cells are round with block-like chromatin, often with smudge cells, occur in older adults, and show a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
MCL cells have irregular nuclei but are clonal CD5+ cyclin D1+ B cells in adults, unlike the polyclonal reactive lymphocytosis of pertussis.
EBV lymphocytosis consists of large reactive lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm scalloped by RBCs rather than small clefted mature lymphocytes.

2987.recognize_zh: 上方巨噬細胞的空泡內含被吞噬的核碎片與紫紅色物質（噬血/噬細胞現象），下方另一顆巨噬細胞細胞質充滿空泡；周圍的骨髓前驅細胞顆粒粗大但巨大顆粒不明顯。
features: Large macrophage with a vesicular nucleus and cytoplasmic vacuoles containing engulfed dense nuclear material and magenta particles
Second macrophage with extensively vacuolated, bubbly cytoplasm
Surrounding myelocytes/metamyelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules
Band neutrophil with fragmented granular cytoplasm and a lymphocyte
Distinct giant granules are not clearly identified in this field
2987.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large macrophages. One contains cytoplasmic vacuoles with engulfed dense nuclear material and magenta particles, consistent with phagocytosis of cells or cell fragments; the other shows extensive cytoplasmic vacuolation. Surrounding granulocytic precursors show coarse granulation, but definitive giant granules are not clearly seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, as seen in the accelerated phase of Chediak-Higashi syndrome; confirmation of giant granules elsewhere on the smear is required.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic debris in reactive proliferations without cytopenias or the clinical HLH picture.
Familial HLH lacks giant granules in granulocytes; genotype distinguishes it from CHS.
Storage cells have fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper or foamy cytoplasm rather than discrete vacuoles with engulfed cells.

2795.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，一團間質性淋巴球聚集的細胞膜呈強棕色陽性，周圍造血細胞陰性；此圖抗體未標示，依標題推測為 T 細胞標記（如 CD3），代表聚集以 T 細胞為主。
features: Well-defined interstitial lymphoid aggregate with strong membranous brown staining
Positive cells are small, densely packed lymphocytes
Scattered positive lymphocytes spilling into surrounding interstitium
Surrounding myeloid and erythroid precursors negative with hematoxylin counterstain
Fat spaces and trabecular edge present; no paratrabecular location of the aggregate
2795.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow core biopsy highlights a discrete interstitial lymphoid aggregate with strong membranous staining of the majority of its small lymphocytes, along with scattered positive cells in the adjacent interstitium. Background hematopoietic cells are negative. The antibody is not labeled on the image; assuming a pan-T-cell marker such as CD3, the aggregate is T-cell predominant. In a patient treated with rituximab, a T-cell rich aggregate with few or no PAX5-positive B cells is consistent with rituximab-associated marrow T-cell hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: A residual lymphoma aggregate would be predominantly PAX5/CD79a-positive, since CD20 may be lost after rituximab.
PTCL shows cytologically atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss (CD5, CD7) and a clonal TCR rearrangement.
Ordinary benign aggregates are also T-cell rich but contain a B-cell component and occur without anti-CD20 therapy.

2347.recognize_zh: 高倍切片中大片粉紅色無定形、帶細纖維紋路的基質，只有一小群小而圓、深染核的造血細胞與沿微血管排列的紅血球，旁邊是萎縮的小脂肪空泡，呈現骨髓膠狀轉化。
features: Abundant pale eosinophilic, amorphous extracellular matrix with delicate fibrillar texture
