Small cluster of residual hematopoietic cells with small round, densely hyperchromatic nuclei (likely erythroid precursors/lymphocytes)
Capillaries containing red cells coursing through the matrix
Small clear vacuoles representing atrophic fat cells
Occasional isolated stromal/spindle cells within the matrix
2347.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows extensive pale eosinophilic amorphous extracellular material with a delicate fibrillar texture. A small cluster of residual hematopoietic cells with small round hyperchromatic nuclei is present, along with capillaries containing red cells and scattered small atrophic fat vacuoles. No abnormal infiltrate is seen. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation of the marrow.

ddx.vs: Amyloid shows Congo red positivity with apple-green birefringence and is more glassy, while this matrix is Alcian blue positive.
Edema and hemorrhage lack the fibrillar mucoid ground substance and adipocyte atrophy.
Necrotic cells show loss of nuclear detail with eosinophilic debris, unlike these intact hyperchromatic nuclei.

2283.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成片的中大型芽細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質少，許多細胞核呈摺疊或腦回狀（convoluted）且有核裂，符合淋巴芽細胞；T 系需靠流式（cytoplasmic CD3）確認。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio
Nuclei irregular, folded, indented or convoluted with nuclear clefts
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Scant pale-to-moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Few scattered small vacuoles; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Residual normal hematopoiesis not evident in this field
2283.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive-appearing aggregate of monotonous blasts replacing normal hematopoietic elements. The blasts are medium to large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, irregular folded to convoluted nuclei with clefts, finely dispersed chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is scant, pale blue, and agranular, without Auer rods. Morphology is that of lymphoblasts; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, TdT). Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; B-ALL is separated by CD19/CD79a/PAX5 expression without cytoplasmic CD3 on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML with minimal differentiation also has agranular, cytochemically MPO-negative blasts, but expresses CD13/CD33/CD117 (often MPO by flow) and lacks cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.dx: Sézary cell / leukemic mature T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Sézary cells have condensed, mature cerebriform chromatin rather than fine blastic chromatin and are TdT and CD34 negative.
Blastoid MCL is CD5+ cyclin D1+ and TdT negative, whereas T-lymphoblasts are TdT+ with cCD3.

2027.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E：整片組織被瀰漫、密集的藍紫色淋巴樣細胞浸潤取代，表面有粉紅色的纖維素／糜爛層，底部延伸到脂肪組織，正常結構消失；在移植病人身上，這種破壞性浸潤要想到 PTLD。
features: Low-power view of tissue diffusely replaced by a dense cellular infiltrate
Effacement of normal architecture without discernible follicles or glands
Pink fibrinous/eroded surface layer at the top edge
Infiltrate extends into underlying adipose tissue at the bottom
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
2027.describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows tissue diffusely effaced by a dense, sheet-like cellular infiltrate with no recognizable follicles or native structures. The surface is covered by a pink fibrinous layer suggesting erosion, and the infiltrate extends into adipose tissue at the deep margin. Cellular composition cannot be assessed at this magnification. In a transplant recipient, the destructive diffuse infiltrate is suggestive of post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, requiring high-power evaluation, immunohistochemistry and EBER in situ hybridization for subtyping.

ddx.dx: Non-destructive PTLD (plasmacytic or florid follicular hyperplasia)
ddx.vs: Non-destructive PTLD preserves the underlying architecture with follicles and sinuses, whereas this infiltrate effaces the tissue.
Monomorphic PTLD shows sheets of large transformed cells on high power, while polymorphic PTLD shows a full range of B-cell maturation; low power cannot separate them.

ddx.dx: Severe acute rejection or infection-related inflammation
ddx.vs: Rejection and infectious infiltrates are T-cell rich and mixed with neutrophils and eosinophils, without EBV-positive clonal B cells or plasma cells.

1963.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中單一顆異型淋巴樣細胞，細胞核不規則折疊、分葉，染色質粗糙團塊狀，胞質呈深藍色並有小空泡；這種深嗜鹼性胞質的漿細胞樣/免疫母細胞樣淋巴球在 AITL 周邊血中可見，但型態本身不具特異性。
features: Single medium-to-large lymphoid cell roughly twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Irregular, folded to lobulated nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin; nucleoli not distinct
Moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small clear vacuoles
Cytoplasmic basophilia accentuated at the periphery, plasmacytoid-appearing
Background normochromic red cells without rouleaux; a small platelet clump at lower left
1963.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical lymphoid cell with an irregular, folded and lobulated nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin, and a moderate amount of deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. The red cells are normochromic and a small platelet clump is present. This cell has plasmacytoid or immunoblastic features; such circulating atypical lymphoid cells and plasmacytoid cells may be seen in angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, but the morphology is not specific and requires flow cytometry (for example CD10-positive, surface CD3-negative T cells) for interpretation.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes typically have abundant cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells with basophilia at the edges and a round rather than lobulated nucleus.
Sezary cells have a cerebriform, tightly grooved nucleus with scant pale cytoplasm rather than abundant deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Circulating plasma cell or plasmacytoid lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have an eccentric round nucleus with a perinuclear hof, whereas this cell has a central lobulated nucleus.
ATLL cells show polylobated flower-shaped nuclei with dense chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm, with HTLV-1 serology positivity.

1899.recognize_zh: 低倍下黏膜組織（邊緣可見腺體/絨毛狀黏膜）被密集的深藍色淋巴細胞浸潤，形成多個擴大、結節狀的淋巴聚集並破壞正常黏膜結構，可對應套細胞淋巴瘤造成的淋巴瘤性息肉症（lymphomatous polyposis）。
features: Low-power view of mucosal tissue with residual glandular/villous mucosa at the edges
Dense, diffuse and vaguely nodular lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and submucosa
Multiple enlarged nodules with slightly paler centers and darker peripheral cuffs
Monotonous dark-staining small cells at this magnification
Distortion and effacement of normal mucosal architecture
1899.describe_en: Low-power section of mucosa-lined tissue, likely gastrointestinal, shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate forming multiple expanded nodules that efface the normal architecture, with residual glandular mucosa at the surface. The nodules have slightly paler centers surrounded by darker cuffs, raising the possibility of a nodular or mantle-zone growth pattern. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the context of the title, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma involving the gastrointestinal tract; cyclin D1 and SOX11 immunostains are required.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and well-defined mantles, and are cyclin D1 negative with polytypic light chains.
MALT lymphoma shows marginal zone/monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and plasmacytic differentiation, and is cyclin D1 and CD5 negative.
FL forms back-to-back follicles of centrocytes and centroblasts that are CD10/BCL6 positive and cyclin D1 negative.

1707.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆被大量粗大紫色顆粒填滿的細胞，核被顆粒遮蔽，細胞邊緣破裂、顆粒散落到周圍，這種密集的嗜鹼性（metachromatic）顆粒是肥大細胞的線索。
features: Large cell packed with coarse, dense purple (metachromatic) cytoplasmic granules
Nucleus largely obscured by overlying granules
Ruptured cell membrane with granules spilled into the surrounding background
Irregular cell outline with small cytoplasmic projections
Background red cells without other notable abnormality in this field
1707.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large circulating cell whose cytoplasm is filled with coarse, dark purple metachromatic granules that obscure the nucleus. The cell is partially disrupted, with granules dispersed around its periphery. The red cells in the field are unremarkable. In the appropriate setting, circulating mast cells of this type are suggestive of mast cell leukemia; confirmation requires a marrow aspirate mast cell count (at least 20%), tryptase, CD117/CD25 expression and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with a lobulated nucleus and fewer, water-soluble granules, whereas mast cells have a round nucleus and densely packed granules; tryptase/CD117 staining separates them.
Abnormal promyelocytes have azurophilic red-purple granules, a reniform or bilobed nucleus and often Auer rods, and are MPO-strongly positive rather than tryptase-positive.
A crushed neutrophil or eosinophil shows fine or orange-red granules and recognizable lobulated chromatin rather than coarse dark metachromatic granules.

1643.recognize_zh: 洋紅色染色勾勒出一圈圈平行排列、如木桶箍般的纖維（ring/annular fibers），環繞著含紅血球的腔隙，這是脾臟紅髓靜脈竇（splenic sinus）基底膜的特徵性環狀結構。
features: Magenta-stained basement membrane fibers arranged as parallel transverse bars and closed rings
Rings outline vascular channels (sinuses) containing pale red cells and sinus lining cells
Intervening cords with scattered nucleated cells and red cells
Occasional dark-staining cells within cords and sinuses
Architecture of red pulp sinuses and cords; no white pulp in this field
1643.describe_en: Section of spleen stained with a basement membrane stain (most likely PAS) shows the red pulp, in which the sinuses are outlined by parallel, hoop-like ring fibers seen in longitudinal section as ladder-like bars and in cross section as closed rings. The sinuses contain red cells and lining cells, and the intervening splenic cords contain scattered nucleated cells. Findings are consistent with normal splenic red pulp demonstrating the annular (ring) fibers of the sinus basement membrane.

ddx.dx: Reticulin framework of lymph node or marrow
ddx.vs: Reticulin in node or marrow forms a delicate branching meshwork rather than the regular transverse hoops encircling sinuses that are unique to splenic red pulp.
Littoral cell angioma forms discrete nodules of anastomosing channels lined by tall CD8-negative, CD68+/CD21+ cells with papillary projections, not an evenly distributed normal sinus framework.

1451.recognize_zh: 三格組合圖：左為周邊血（紅血球大小不一、偏大）；中為骨髓切片，多個中小型巨核細胞只有單一圓形不分葉的核；右為骨髓抹片，巨核細胞同樣呈單核、偏心的非分葉核；「單葉/低分葉巨核細胞」是 del(5q) MDS 的特徵線索。
features: Composite of peripheral blood, bone marrow biopsy and bone marrow aspirate panels
Megakaryocytes of small to normal size with single round, non-lobated (monolobated) nuclei
Megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic (biopsy) or basophilic-gray (aspirate) cytoplasm
Peripheral blood with mild anisocytosis and some large oval red cells; one lymphoid-appearing nucleated cell
Aspirate background with granulocytic precursors and no obvious excess of blasts
1451.describe_en: Composite image of peripheral blood, bone marrow biopsy and aspirate. The peripheral blood shows mild anisocytosis with some large oval red cells. The biopsy and aspirate show megakaryocytes of small to normal size with characteristic single round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, while the aspirate background shows granulocytic precursors without an obvious excess of blasts. Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), which requires cytogenetic confirmation.

ddx.vs: This shows separated-nuclei or micromegakaryocytes with dysplasia in other lineages and lacks isolated del(5q) on karyotype.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei, the opposite of the monolobated forms here.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity has ring sideroblasts on iron stain and large atypical MPN-like megakaryocytes, with SF3B1 mutation rather than del(5q).

1515.recognize_zh: 一顆大型漿細胞：細胞核圓且明顯偏向一側、染色質中度粗糙，細胞質豐富深藍帶細顆粒，靠近核處較淡（hof），體積遠大於紅血球，屬於型態偏不成熟的骨髓瘤漿細胞；左下另有一顆皺縮深染的退化細胞。
features: Large plasma cell, roughly 2.5-3 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Eccentric round nucleus with moderately coarse chromatin; no clear clock-face pattern
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with fine granular texture and a paler perinuclear zone
Low to moderate N:C ratio
Adjacent small, crenated, hyperchromatic cell consistent with a degenerated cell or drying artifact
Sparse red cells with a fine granular background
1515.describe_en: Smear shows a single large plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus, moderately coarse chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone. The cell is considerably larger than a normal mature plasma cell and lacks the classic clock-face chromatin, suggesting an immature (plasmacytic) morphology. An adjacent small crenated hyperchromatic cell appears degenerated. The specimen type cannot be confirmed from this single field. Findings are consistent with a neoplastic plasma cell of multiple myeloma in the stated context.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin and a distinct hof, and are polytypic.
Plasmablasts have larger nuclei with prominent central nucleoli and finer chromatin, often EBV (EBER) positive in immunodeficient patients.
Immunoblasts have a central nucleus with a prominent nucleolus and less eccentric placement, seen in viral reactive states.
Proerythroblasts have a central round nucleus with fine chromatin, nucleoli and deeply blue cytoplasm with blebs rather than an eccentric nucleus with perinuclear clearing.

60395.recognize_zh: 這顆細胞核染色質濃縮，分成約 3 個葉並以細絲（filament）相連，細胞質淡粉紅且布滿細小特異顆粒，是成熟的分節嗜中性球（segmented neutrophil）。
features: Mature granulocyte about 1.5 times the diameter of a red cell
Nucleus divided into approximately three lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with abundant fine specific (neutrophilic) granules
Surrounding red cells show mild crenation, likely a drying artifact
60395.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil among red cells. The nucleus is segmented into approximately three lobes connected by thin filaments, with condensed chromatin, and the cytoplasm is pale with numerous fine specific granules. There is no toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuolation, and nuclear lobation is within the normal range (2-5 lobes). Findings are consistent with a normal segmented neutrophil.

ddx.vs: Band neutrophils have a continuous C- or S-shaped nucleus without true filamentous separation between lobes.
Eosinophils usually have bilobed nuclei and large refractile orange-red granules, unlike the fine lilac granules here.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes (or >5% with five lobes), whereas this cell has about three.

107.recognize_zh: 周邊血液可見明顯血小板增多與數個嗜鹼性球（basophil），骨髓切片高度細胞化並有大量成群的巨核細胞，網狀纖維染色顯示纖維明顯增加；這些型態會讓人想到 PMF/ET，必須以 BCR-ABL1 檢測確認為 CML 加速期。
features: Peripheral blood: marked thrombocytosis with numerous platelets including some large forms
Peripheral blood: basophils (two in one field) with coarse dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus, alongside mature neutrophils
Bone marrow biopsy: hypercellular marrow with marked megakaryocytic proliferation forming loose and tight clusters
Megakaryocytes vary from small to large with hypolobated to hyperchromatic nuclei; some appear atypical
IHC (likely CD34): highlights sinusoidal/vascular endothelium and scattered positive mononuclear cells without large aggregates; megakaryocytes negative
Reticulin stain: diffuse increase in reticulin fibers with frequent intersections
107.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked thrombocytosis with occasional large platelets, mature neutrophils, and increased basophils; red cells are largely normocytic without prominent teardrop forms in these fields. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with marked megakaryocytic hyperplasia, including clusters of megakaryocytes of variable size with hypolobated and hyperchromatic nuclei, and a background of granulocytic precursors. An immunostain (likely CD34) highlights prominent vasculature and scattered positive mononuclear cells without sheets or large clusters of blasts. Reticulin stain shows a diffuse increase in reticulin fibers. Although the megakaryocytic proliferation and fibrosis mimic primary myelofibrosis or essential thrombocythemia, with BCR-ABL1 (p210) positivity and severe thrombocytosis these findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, accelerated phase.

ddx.vs: PMF shows similar clustered atypical megakaryocytes and reticulin fibrosis, but it lacks BCR-ABL1 and usually carries JAK2, CALR, or MPL mutations; basophilia favors CML.
ET has large hyperlobulated staghorn megakaryocytes without significant fibrosis or basophilia and is BCR-ABL1 negative.

Chronic phase has predominantly small hypolobated megakaryocytes with granulocytic hyperplasia; accelerated features (per WHO 2016) include platelets >1000 x10^9/L unresponsive to therapy, basophils >=20%, or blasts 10-19%.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity shows dysplastic erythropoiesis with ring sideroblasts (often SF3B1 mutation) and is BCR-ABL1 negative.

captions: Peripheral blood: basophil with coarse dark granules and a neutrophil amid increased platelets.
Peripheral blood: two basophils, one neutrophil, and marked thrombocytosis.
Bone marrow core, low power H&E: hypercellular marrow with numerous megakaryocytes.
Medium power H&E: clusters of megakaryocytes of variable size in a granulocytic background.
High power H&E: clustered megakaryocytes with hypolobated and hyperchromatic nuclei.
IHC (likely CD34): vascular endothelium and scattered positive mononuclear cells; megakaryocytes negative.
IHC (likely CD34), second field: prominent vessels and scattered positive cells without blast clusters.
IHC (likely CD34), third field: scattered positive round cells and vessels in a loosely cellular area.
Reticulin stain: diffuse increase in reticulin fibers with frequent intersections.

43.recognize_zh: 兒童骨髓切片明顯低細胞性、以脂肪為主，殘存造血呈斑片狀並以紅血球系小島為主；免疫染色顯示散在的小型巨核細胞，另一標記只標出零星細胞（未見芽細胞增加），抹片中可見雙核且胞質深藍的不成熟細胞，符合兒童難治性血球減少症（RCC）。
features: Low power: markedly hypocellular core for age, predominantly fat with patchy residual hematopoiesis; separate more cellular aspirate clot fragments
Residual hematopoiesis in small patchy foci, mostly erythroid islands with immature erythroid precursors and relatively few maturing granulocytes
IHC (megakaryocytic marker, unlabeled): scattered megakaryocytes of variable size including small forms
IHC (unlabeled, likely CD34): only scattered isolated positive cells, without blast clusters
Aspirate: immature cells with fine chromatin and binucleate cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs (possibly dysplastic erythroid precursor or small megakaryocyte)
43.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypocellular for age, composed largely of fat with patchy foci of residual hematopoiesis; separately submitted clot fragments are more cellular. At higher power the residual hematopoiesis is predominantly erythroid, forming small islands of immature precursors, with relatively reduced granulopoiesis. Immunohistochemistry highlights scattered megakaryocytes including small forms, and a second stain (not labeled, likely CD34) marks only isolated single cells without clusters, supporting no increase in blasts. Aspirate smears show immature cells with fine chromatin and occasional binucleate precursors with deeply basophilic, blebbed cytoplasm; the degree of dysplasia is difficult to quantify from these fields. In an 8-year-old with pancytopenia and an abnormal karyotype involving der(5)t(1;5), findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: SAA marrow is often nearly empty of hematopoiesis with no patchy immature erythroid islands, no dysplasia and no clonal cytogenetic abnormality, whereas RCC shows patchy left-shifted erythropoiesis, small megakaryocytes and here an abnormal karyotype.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure syndrome (e.g., Fanconi anemia)
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps with hypocellular RCC; exclusion requires chromosome breakage testing, telomere length and germline genetic studies rather than histology.

ddx.dx: MDS with excess blasts / childhood MDS-EB
ddx.vs: MDS-EB has at least 2% blood or 5% marrow blasts and CD34-positive blast clusters, whereas here CD34-type staining shows only isolated cells.
PNH is identified by flow cytometric loss of GPI-anchored proteins (FLAER, CD59) rather than morphology, and lacks the clonal der(5)t(1;5) karyotype.

43.stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; IHC (unlabeled markers, red chromogen)
captions: IHC (red chromogen, megakaryocytic marker): scattered megakaryocytes including small forms in hypocellular marrow
Low power: markedly hypocellular fatty core with separate cellular clot fragments below
Medium power: patchy residual hematopoiesis among fat cells
High power: small islands of immature erythroid precursors with few maturing granulocytes
IHC (red chromogen, likely CD34): only scattered isolated positive cells without clusters
BM aspirate: immature cells with fine chromatin and occasional abnormal nuclear forms
BM aspirate: binucleate immature cell with deeply basophilic, blebbed cytoplasm

62699.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，不是形態學影像：淋巴球門控下 CD2 對 CD7 雙參數圖，可見一群 CD2 與 CD7 皆表現的族群（綠色），與 CD2 較亮的 T 細胞（藍色）部分重疊，左下角為 CD2−/CD7− 族群（洋紅色）。需配合 CD3、CD16、CD56、CD57、KIR 等標記判讀 NK 細胞增生。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD2-PC7 (y-axis) versus CD7-APC700 (x-axis), log scale
Green population: CD2 positive (slightly dimmer than blue population) and CD7 positive, forming a dense cluster
Blue population: CD2 brighter, CD7 positive, overlapping the green cluster (likely T cells)
Magenta population in lower-left quadrant: CD2 negative, CD7 negative (likely B cells), with a minor tail of events
No distinct CD7-negative or CD2-negative abnormal population is evident on this single plot; color-to-lineage assignment is inferred
62699.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes displays CD2 versus CD7. A dense population (green) expresses CD2 and CD7 and overlaps with a CD2-brighter population (blue), while a separate CD2-negative/CD7-negative population (magenta) lies in the lower-left quadrant. Lineage assignment of the colored populations is not labeled and must be inferred from the full panel; in the reference case, the green events presumably represent the expanded NK-cell population. This single plot cannot establish the diagnosis alone; NK-cell clonality/abnormality should be supported by CD3-negative, CD16/CD56 expression patterns, CD57, and restricted KIR isoform expression, together with a persistent (>6 months) NK lymphocytosis, consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are surface CD3+ with TCR alpha/beta (or gamma/delta) expression and clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas CLPD-NK cells are surface CD3-negative.
Reactive NK expansions are transient with polytypic KIR expression and normal CD56/CD16/CD94 patterns, lacking the persistent restricted KIR or aberrant antigen loss seen in CLPD-NK.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia presents with fulminant illness, EBV positivity, and often CD56-bright atypical cells, unlike the indolent course of CLPD-NK.
